deckhand.block:
Deckhand Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Quadruped at rest — all four flat plantigrade palms down, heels flat — and he rears back onto his haunches (hind feet plus rump) whenever both forepaws are needed, standing full upright on his hind legs only in scared and cheer.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
Every one of the eighteen frames: yellow sou'wester rain hat on a knotted chin cord, navy rain cape with one brass clasp offset at his RIGHT throat, and one tan coil of rope that never leaves his body — riding his right shoulder by default, otherwise in a paw with the line running back to him, or wrapped around him.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He is a raccoon, so every hero pose transfers one to one — but paint Jimothy's body canon, not a trash panda: round and spherical, no visible neck, head perched high above the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a SHORT STUBBY tail that never streams, curls out behind or ropes water. Plantigrade always: flat palms, five long spread fingers, heel down — never knuckles, never knuckle-walking. Standing four-square means all four palms are down and no limb is free, so any frame that holds a cup, a coil or an open-armed gesture is sat back on his haunches instead; that swap is already written into each frame below and must not be reversed. The animation work is the costume: the cape is cloth (wet vertical folds at rest, snapped flat behind him in the air, flogging in a run), the rope is line with real weight and sag, and the hat is tied on, so it slips onto its cord in flee, ko, dizzy and splash without ever separating from him.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing four-square facing camera, all four flat palms down, weight settled back on his heels, the tan coil riding his right shoulder and dragging that shoulder visibly lower than the other. Cape hangs in wet vertical folds, one fat bead of rain gathering at the front of the yellow brim, face calm and patient like a man watching for a boat that is nine minutes late.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sat upright on his haunches, the coil lifted off the shoulder and cradled in both flat palms against his belly, cape gathered in wet folds over his hips and never spreading onto anything below him. Hat tipped back off his brow so the whole face reads, eyes half-lidded and content, looking somewhere past the camera at water we cannot see.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Still sat on his haunches with the coil resting across his own knees as a table and an unprinted paper tray of ferry-galley clam strips balanced on it, touching his chest — that is the joke. The back of one flat palm nudges the hat brim up while the other lifts a strip halfway to a full cheek, tartar sauce on the whiskers, cape hanging wet down his back.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Flattened low on all fours, palms flat and heels down, haunches up and loaded, cape slid forward over the shoulders and bunched at the neck. The coil stays lashed on his right shoulder and swings down against his ribs — nothing in the jaws — hat brim jammed to the eyebrows, eyes locked forward.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne, limbs spread wide and belly forward, cape snapped dead straight behind him like a signal flag, hat held on by the taut chin cord, mouth open in delight. One end of the rope has sprung free into two open loops that stay tight behind his hips and overlap his body, the coil itself still on the shoulder.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Body low and the weight absorbed through the shoulders, one forepaw planted flat with the fingers spread while the other is already reaching up for the brim that has bounced down over one eye, whiskers forward. The coil has slid forward off the shoulder and heaps against his own forearm, cape flopped over the far shoulder, a tight burst of grit and spray coming off the planted palm alone.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on sprint to the right, body low, legs at full stretch, cape streaming off to the left behind him. The coil is hooked over his right shoulder — the far one at this angle — swinging out of rhythm with his stride, the brass clasp showing at his right throat, one flat palm clamping the hat down.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat out to the right, legs fully extended, cape horizontal, the coil bouncing hard off his right hip with one loop just starting to unspool but staying inside his own outline. Hat mashed flat to the skull with the chin cord snapped straight back, eyes wide, short white speed streaks and torn rain kept tight behind his heels.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: Held completely still and vibrating: sat back on his haunches with the hind feet planted and locked, both flat palms strangling a plain scorched paper cup at chest height, fur bristled, pupils gone to pinpricks under a trembling yellow brim, the coil quivering on his shoulder. Pale cream-white steam rips off the cup, short jitter lines hug his silhouette and gold-orange fire licks at his heels — the feet do not move.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Reared up on his haunches, both flat palms thrown open and mouth wide in pure astonishment, hat pushed back and cape flung open, a short bight of his own rope arcing off one paw and back to the shoulder coil. Gold bottlecaps, coins and fries come spiralling in along that bight like beads running down a mooring line, every one of them close enough to overlap his body — joy that things come to him, never grabbing.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Reared up on his haunches with arms folded and faintly smug, still wearing the rain hat and rain cape underneath anyway, because he has lashed a black ferry-deck umbrella to his own shoulder coil with a neat little hitch so both paws stay free. The canopy sits directly over his head with the lashing visible running down to the coil, rain shedding off the rim in short streaks that stop at shoulder height.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Crouched back on his haunches at the instant of impact, one forearm across his face and the other holding the coil up in front of him like a buckler, ears flat, one eye squeezed shut, hat brim pressed down, cape bunched at the neck. A blue-violet dome hugs him just past the ears and elbows with rain streaking off the outside and the rope fibres lit along their edges inside.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Up on his hind legs, hugging the coil to his chest like a life ring, head tilted back and up so the brim rides off his brow and the eyes go huge. Cape hem lifting, stubby tail rigid, a hard gull-shaped shadow falling across his chest and face only — nothing cast anywhere below him.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting hard to the left, mouth open in flat panic, hat blown back onto its chin cord and bouncing on his shoulders, cape flogging. Half the coil has unspooled into short flailing loops he has no time to gather, tucked behind his hip and kept inside his own outline, with red speed streaks close to his heels and two sharp shock marks over his head.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Up on his hind legs, both feet planted proud, one arm flung high with the rope still running down from that raised paw so the loop he threw hangs as a perfect open circle just above and slightly behind his head, overlapping his ears — a halo he tied himself. Mouth wide with joy, hat shoved back off the brow, cape thrown open and hanging low to keep his mass in the centre of the frame.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back with his legs in the air, wrapped shin to shoulder in three neat turns of his own rope like a badly parcelled package, undone by the one thing he is good at — the face is wounded professional pride, not pain. The hat has come off onto its cord and lies against his ear with the brim tipped across one eye, the visible eye a dazed swooning half-moon, cape spread flat beneath him, gold stars circling above the brim.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled and sitting up crooked, spiral eyes, tongue out, hat spun around backwards on its cord and the cape twisted up under his chin like a bib. The coil has come undone around HIM — two loops round one ankle, one across his chest, the rest heaped against his own hip — which for a deckhand is the actual injury; stars circling his head, one connected silhouette, nothing loose beside him.

splash.pose: The instant of shock inside an exploding white crown of water that bursts up around his ribs: soaked, fur plastered flat, both arms up, mouth wide, eyes huge, cape sodden and pinned to his flank. One flat palm still grips the rope and the line runs taut for a body length before ending in a frayed knot well inside the frame — he never let go of the tie-off — the yellow hat knocked off onto its cord and resting brim-up against his shoulder.

deckhand.left: Must be painted separately — the coil rides his right shoulder and the brass cape clasp sits offset at his right throat, so mirroring run-r puts both on the wrong side. Cut frames land in assets/skins/deckhand/ as idle.png, sit.png, eat.png, crouch.png, leap.png, land.png, run-r.png, dash-run.png, coffee.png, magnet.png, umbrella.png, shield.png, scared.png, flee.png, cheer.png, ko.png, dizzy.png, splash.png

market.block:
Market Day Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Upright biped at rest — hind feet planted, heels down, stubby tail as counterweight — dropping to plantigrade all-fours ONLY in the six travel frames (crouch, leap, land, run-r, dash-run, flee), where the bag-carrying left forearm still never reaches the road; he is never four-square, because the bag always occupies one arm.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all eighteen: brown kraft grocery bag on the LEFT forearm (full-length baguette, carrot tops, celery, one apple inside), green box satchel on a single diagonal strap over the RIGHT shoulder to the left hip, one scallion (teeth, or behind the right ear when the mouth is busy) — no clothing; the takeaway cup, the umbrella and the dome are power-up props belonging to their one frame only.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He is a raccoon, so every pose in Jimothy's own pack works skeletally — the constraint is the hand budget, not the body: the left forearm is permanently spent on the grocery bag, only the right paw is ever free, and the two frames that need both forelimbs (magnet, shield) put the bag over the head or open across the chest, never on the floor. Jimothy body canon holds in all eighteen: round and spherical, no visible neck, head perched high above the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a SHORT STUBBY ringed tail — never the long streaming rope of a lean trash panda. Plantigrade always: flat palms, five long spread fingers, heels down; no knuckles, and no tiptoes even in cheer. Head size is the scale check — the skull must be the same pixel height in every frame; the bag is the thing that changes shape (full, crushed, open wide, tipped, splitting), never him.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Upright on his hind legs facing camera, heels down, stubby tail counterweighting behind; left forearm cradling the overfull kraft bag at his hip, right paw hanging loose and open, scallion clamped sideways in his teeth. The bag is stuffed past its rim with free carrot tops three different stallholders kept adding, and his eyes cut just off camera with the mild embarrassment of a raccoon who did not ask for any of this.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sitting back on his haunches off duty, the bag leaned against his thigh with one flat palm resting on top of it out of habit, satchel slid into his lap with the clasps undone, scallion still in his teeth like a toothpick. Ears relaxed, eyes half-lidded on nothing in particular — the quiet frame: he shopped for a bigger household than the one waiting at home.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sitting beside the slumped-open bag with the baguette out and visibly half gone, one broken end held up in his right paw and the other cheek packed full, scallion parked behind his right ear. Eyes squeezed shut in bliss, crumbs caught in his chest fur and in the open satchel and none falling free — dinner, several hours early.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Three-point and loaded: both hind feet and his flat right palm down, haunches up, left forearm clamping the bag hard against his chest with the baguette standing straight up out of it like a mast. Shoulders tilted from the missing limb, eyes locked forward, scallion clenched in his teeth, the produce already leaning back from the launch.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne, belly forward, back legs kicked wide, bag hugged to his chest with the baguette raked back along his spine like a rudder, its tip no more than a head past his rump, satchel flown up on its taut strap. One escaped carrot hangs against his ear and overlaps it, and he is grinning far too wide to have noticed.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Weight absorbed low, right palm planted flat with fingers spread and a tight spray bursting off it, left forearm still clamping the bag to his chest, satchel swung forward and thumped against his belly. Whiskers pushed forward, one eye scrunched from the impact, a carrot and a celery stalk floating an inch above the bag mouth and still overlapping it.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on sprint to the right, right flank to camera, body low and legs at full extension: the satchel streams back off his near hip and the bag is clamped under his far arm, its brown rim and one carrot showing above his chest line with the baguette raked back along his spine. Ears laid flat, scallion still in his teeth, mouth shut and grimly professional.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: The same sprint flat out — legs stretched to the limit, ears pinned, eyes wide and white-rimmed, satchel flying horizontal, baguette raked back hard over the bag rim. Warm amber speed streaks tear off his heels and hips and touch him, and one carrot tumbles just behind his tail, overlapping it.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: Standing dead still and vibrating: hind feet planted, heels down, fur lifted in bristles, pupils shrunk to pinpricks, jitter lines hugging his outline and a faint double image on the scallion in his teeth. A takeaway cup is wedged into the bag mouth beside the baguette because he has no paw left for it, pale blush-cream steam curling off it, small amber fire licks at his heels.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Upright with the bag hauled wide open in both arms like a net, head tipped back, mouth open in pure astonishment that the world is handing him things, scallion clamped in the corner of his teeth. Gold bottlecaps and loose produce spiral in tight and drop through the top — the outermost cap overlapping his ear — and the satchel has flapped open and is catching two of them.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Upright under an open umbrella held high in his right paw, tilted right off to his left so the bag underneath stays bone dry while his own right shoulder takes the whole soaking. Smug, ears flat, a drip hanging off his chin, short rain streaks shedding off the canopy rim only.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Braced low with the bag hoisted over his head in both arms and his eyes screwed shut, a bright blue-violet dome flaring tight around him with rain streaking off its curve. One carrot has been knocked loose and hangs against the bag mouth inside the dome, satchel swung round behind his back from the force.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Up on his hind legs, bag clutched flat to his chest with his left arm, the baguette pulled out and held up in his right paw like a sword he has no intention of using, eyes huge and rolled straight up at the sky. Ears pinned back, scallion drooping out of his slack open mouth.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Three-quarter sprint toward camera, mouth open in panic, the bag jammed under his left arm, one carrot and one celery stalk spraying tight behind him and overlapping his tail and the bag mouth. Short red-orange speed streaks off his heels and two fat exclamation marks tucked in against his shoulder.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Up on his hind legs, heels down, stretched tall, the baguette punched up on a diagonal in his right paw like a torch with its tip no more than a head above his crown, the bag hoisted in his left with celery and carrot tops popping out of it. Mouth wide open in a joyful shout, eyes shut, scallion behind his right ear, two or three bottlecaps flicking up against his shoulders.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back, long skinny legs in the air, the bag tipped over against his head with produce spilling in a short arc across his ear and cheek and every piece touching him, baguette laid across his chest, satchel flopped open with a carrot resting on his belly. Swooning half-moon eyes, a small dazed smile, scallion still in his teeth, stars circling — first time he has been off his feet all day and he looks quietly relieved about it.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his side with spiral eyes and his tongue lolling, the emptied bag upside down over one ear like a hat he has given up removing, the baguette still spinning with one end resting across his shins in a blur arc. Scallion drooping from his slack mouth, one lone carrot balanced on his nose, and a tight swirl of motion arcs instead of stars so he never reads as the ko.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst: soaked through, right arm thrown up, a white and pale-cyan water crown exploding around his waist, the sodden kraft bag going soft and splitting inside his own left grip. The baguette lies across the crown at his elbow and one carrot is plastered to his shoulder, scallion stuck flat to his cheek, his face pure shock — not at the water, at the bag.

market.left: Must be painted separately: the bag rides the LEFT forearm and the strap crosses right shoulder to left hip, so mirroring swaps the entire costume — and it is not the same picture reversed anyway, because in run-r the bag is on his far side and half-occluded behind his chest, while in run-l it is near-side and fully visible. hardhat.block:
Hard Hat Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Quadruped at rest — plantigrade raccoon, four flat palms down, heel down; he rears onto his hind legs ONLY in coffee, magnet, umbrella, shield, scared and cheer, and never knuckle-walks.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all 18 frames: scuffed orange hard hat on a thin chinstrap; hi-vis sash running LEFT shoulder to RIGHT hip, two reflective stripes, small brass clip where it crosses; a BLANK orange-and-white octagon paddle on a short pole, slung on his back under the sash by default (comes into paws only in sit, eat, umbrella, shield, and lies on his chest in ko); a dented steel thermos on a short cord clipped at his right hip. The black lunch pail is the one extra, in eat only, and it rests on him.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He is hero Jimothy's skeleton exactly, so every pose transfers one for one — round and spherical, no visible neck, head perched high above the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a STUBBY ringed tail in all eighteen frames (never streaming, never a rope of water). Hands are the giveaway: flat palms, five long spread fingers, heel down, plantigrade in every frame including the runs. The honest work on this skin is wardrobe physics, not anatomy — the chinstrap is what lets the hat survive leap, land, dizzy and splash, and the sash is a loose loop that swings and skews but never leaves the left-shoulder-to-right-hip diagonal. A frame that needs a paw for a prop must rear him up; four-square means no free limb, which is why the paddle rides on his back.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing four-square facing camera, round and scrunched, weight even on four flat palms, stubby ringed tail hanging straight down, no limb free. Hat level and scuffed on its chinstrap, both sash stripes catching the streetlight, blank octagon slung on his back with the pole angled past his right shoulder, thermos still on its hip cord — face calm and faintly tired, a raccoon who has stood in this exact spot for thirty years.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sat back on his haunches on nothing — no curb, no kerbstone, no pavement — with the paddle pulled round and tucked under one arm so the octagon props behind his shoulder like a backrest. Hat pushed back to show the sweat-flattened dent ring in his head fur, both flat palms cupping the thermos lid with one curl of pale cream steam; shoulders down, eyes soft, off duty for exactly ten minutes.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sitting with the paddle laid flat across his lap as a tray and the open black lunch pail resting on it against his chest, half a wax-paper sandwich held in both palms mid-bite, cheeks full. Hat tipped back, thermos lid balanced on the pail lid, one crumb on his chin — the joke is that somebody at home still cuts it in half for him.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Flattened low on all fours with his chest almost down and his haunches loaded high, palms spread flat, stubby tail low — nothing painted under him. Hat brim shoved down so his eyes glint out from beneath it, sash swung forward loose on his chest but still on the same diagonal, octagon riding flat on his back, whiskers pinned.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne, limbs thrown wide but tucked inside the frame, round belly forward, stubby tail flicked up, mouth open in a delighted whoop. The hat lifts a half inch and is caught by the chinstrap under his jaw, the sash flags back off his shoulder, and the back-slung octagon swings out level with his hip — nothing trails, nothing sprays.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Front paws planted hard on flat spread palms with the elbows bent, body low and round, stubby tail up for balance, whiskers forward. The hat drops over his brow on impact and the sash swings across his chest; a tight puff of grit sprays off his palms and stays touching them — no dust cloud, no cast shadow, no gravel lying on a floor.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on hop to the right, spine bowed and compact rather than stretched long, back legs extended, one flat palm reaching forward. Hat pinned low over his eyes, sash streaming back with the two stripes smearing into a short light trail, octagon riding above his hip on his back, thermos bouncing on its cord.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: The same side-on sprint flat out — legs at full stretch, ears flat, eyes wide, cheeks pushed back by the wind, body still round. Hat brim pressed flat, sash horizontal like a banner, and short orange-and-white speed streaks plus warm gold sparks starting at his hind claws and touching him, none reaching more than half a body width back.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: He is NOT MOVING: reared up on his hind legs with both heels flat and planted, whole body vibrating in place, fur bristled, pupils two different sizes, teeth clenched in a wired grin. One paw round the thermos lid slopping over the rim, the other clamped on the hat brim to hold it down on his shaking head, pale blush-cream steam, short jitter lines at his elbows and small warm-gold heat licks at his feet — no lean, no stride, no speed streaks.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Reared up with the hat lifted off and held upturned in both flat palms as a bucket, chinstrap still round his throat so it never leaves him, the sweat-dent ring in his head fur finally showing, mouth open in astonished delight. A tight spiral of gold bottlecaps and fries pours in and touches his paws and the hat rim the whole way; the ones he misses ring off the rim with little warm-orange impact sparks.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Reared up holding the blank orange-and-white octagon flat overhead in both paws with the elbows bent so it clears the hat brim by about an inch — never at full arm stretch. Short rain ticks tight around him and two proper gutter streams pouring off the hat brim; eyes half-lidded, thoroughly smug, because the paddle is decoration and the hat is doing all the work.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: The instant of the hit — the blank octagon snapped up flat in front of his chest with a bright blue-violet dome flaring off its face, rain and grit streaking around the curve and staying inside half a body width. Head turned away, one eye squeezed shut, hat knocked down over his brow, one hind heel skidding back: braced, flinching, saved.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Reared up with his head cranked back to the sky, both flat palms clamped down on the hat brim because three generations of instinct say the hat handles it. Eyes huge and white-ringed, mouth a small flat line, sash jumped up loose on his chest but still on the same left-to-right diagonal, thermos swinging out on its cord.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting to the left in open-mouthed panic, one flat palm jammed on the hat so it cannot fly off, the other pumping, hind legs at full stretch. The thermos stays clipped and bounces off his hip with a short arc of coffee flicking back onto his own flank, short red-orange streaks at his heels and one small white shock-burst at his shoulder — nothing dropped, no spill trail, no painted punctuation.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Reared up tall, one arm punched up with the elbow bent so the fist stops just above the hat rather than at full stretch, the other paw a fist at his chest, mouth wide open in a whoop. Hat knocked back on his head, both reflective stripes lit, octagon riding on his back — the road is still never finished, but this bit is.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back, all four skinny limbs in the air, tongue out, eyelids swooning half-moons, three gold stars circling close enough to touch his ears. The hat has tipped onto its side against his ear and stays touching him brim-up, the sash lies slack across his belly, and the octagon has swung round to lie flat on his chest — his face says occupational hazard, third time this shift.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his side with spiral eyes and his tongue lolling, stars orbiting close overhead and overlapping the hat. The hat has been spun clean backwards so the brim sits over the back of his neck, the octagon has slid round and lies across his upper flank still hooked under the sash, and two stray broom bristles and a little grit are stuck in his fur.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst: soaked through, both arms up, mouth open in shock, fur plastered flat to a much smaller raccoon inside an exploding white crown of water that touches him all the way round. Hat tipped back on his crown with water bursting past and under the brim so it is still the one dry thing in the picture, stripes glowing hard in the dark water, octagon just clearing his shoulder — nothing detached, nothing going under.

hardhat.left: Must be painted separately — the sash diagonal (left shoulder to right hip), the brass cross-clip, the right-hip thermos and the back-slung octagon all reverse under a mirror, so the whole costume would read backwards on every leftward hop. scout.block:
Scoutmaster Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Upright plantigrade biped at rest — heels down, flat palms free, never four-square — dropping onto all fours ONLY in the six travel/impact frames (crouch, leap, land, run-r, dash-run, flee) plus the painted run-l; locked, no silent switches anywhere else.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all 18 frames: navy patch vest with the top two buttons fastened and the hem left open, brass buttons down the placket, a wordless square cream merit patch on HIS RIGHT chest, a small round brass badge low on HIS LEFT hip, and a cream neckerchief knotted square at the throat — nothing else is permanent.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
This is hero Jimothy's body in a costume, so every reference pose transfers one-to-one: round and spherical with NO visible neck, head perched high above the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a SHORT STUBBY tail that never streams, ropes or curls out behind him in any frame. Plantigrade throughout — flat palms, five long spread fingers, heel down; the word "knuckles" does not appear on this sheet. The vest is stiff and swings as one unit from the shoulders, flaring only from the open hem, while the neckerchief is loose cloth that streams, flops and soaks. The single checkable rule: his HEAD is the same pixel height in all 18 frames — if an effect shrinks the head, the effect is too big.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing upright at attention on his hind legs, heels flat, chest pushed out, chin level, long skinny arms straight at his sides with flat palms turned in. Vest square and formal, neckerchief knot dead centre, rain beading on his shoulders and both badges catching a little streetlight.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sitting upright on his haunches, back straight and knees together, one flat palm smoothing the merit patch against his chest and the other laid on his knee, stubby tail tucked. Off duty and still sitting like he expects to be inspected, mouth a small content line.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sitting on his haunches toasting a marshmallow on a bent wire held with enormous procedural correctness, cheeks already packed, neckerchief tucked into the vest as a bib; the little Sterno tin rests against one hind foot and the dented enamel mess-cup is hooked in his other paw. A second marshmallow is already threaded on the wire for a troop that did not come — this is the quiet frame.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Flattened low on all fours, haunches up, elbows out, flat palms spread wide, eyes locked up-street. Neckerchief tails hang forward past his chin and the brass hip badge glints — coiled like he is demonstrating correct technique to a troop that is not there.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne, limbs spread but reaching no further than a body width, belly forward, mouth open and delighted, stubby tail up. The open hem of the vest flares back off his ribs while the fastened top holds the square merit patch flat and readable, and the neckerchief streams straight back like a troop pennant.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run

A tight ring of spray bursting off his own palms and nothing else beneath him — whiskers forward, extremely satisfied with the landing.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Standing dead straight at parade posture under a small, carefully hand-mended umbrella gripped in one flat palm, canopy tucked low over his ears and barely wider than his shoulders, rain bouncing off it close around him. shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game

firstfrost.block:
First Frost Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Upright bipedal at rest — he stands, waits and gestures on his hind legs (idle, sit, eat, coffee, magnet, umbrella, shield, scared, cheer), and drops forward onto his ONE free front palm only for the six travel frames (crouch, leap, land, run-r, dash-run, flee); the cup paw never touches the ground in any of the eighteen, so he is never four-square.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all 18: the red hand-knit scarf, double-wrapped at the throat with its fringed end down his viewer-LEFT chest, and the kraft-and-white takeaway coffee cup with a brown lid, always in his viewer-RIGHT front paw and always physically touching his body — the only frame-only additions anywhere on the sheet are the donut (eat) and the small slate-blue umbrella (umbrella), both held against him.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
Jimothy's body canon holds exactly: round and spherical, no visible neck, head perched high above the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a SHORT STUBBY ringed tail — never a long streaming trash-panda tail in any of the eighteen. He is plantigrade — flat palms, five long spread fingers, heel down — and never knuckle-walks, in the crouch, the land or anywhere else. Because one front paw is permanently occupied by the cup, every two-paw pose the hero solves with two paws (cheer, magnet, umbrella, shield, splash) is re-solved here with one free paw plus the scarf and the jaw, and the answer is always the same character truth: he protects the coffee first and himself second. The scarf is his second limb — it streams, catches, wraps and covers an eye — and the breath fog is his signature effect, faint at rest and heavy under exertion.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing upright and settled on his hind legs, front three-quarter high angle, scarf double-wrapped with the fringe down his viewer-left chest, stubby ringed tail curled out to his viewer-left, free paw hanging relaxed, cup up at shoulder height in the viewer-right paw. Eyes squinted content against the chill, one faint white breath plume at the muzzle, pale blush steam rising no higher than his ears — this is the existing painting and it is the master for camera, scale, lighting and costume.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sat back on his haunches with the stubby tail curled around his own feet like a lap blanket and the scarf loosened one turn so it pools in his lap, both paws finally cradling the cup together under his chin, eyes half closed, steam and breath merged into one soft plume across his face. The only frame where he gets to hold it properly, and he is in no hurry — nobody is expecting him anywhere this early.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sitting, cup hugged low and upright against his belly in the cup paw (it never leaves his body), dunking a half-eaten old-fashioned donut into it with the free paw, cheeks packed, eyes shut in total bliss. Sugar already dusted down the red knit and a fat puff of breath fog blooming around the donut.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Compressed low on all threes, hind legs folded, the free palm flat and spread on nothing — plantigrade, five long fingers, heel down — while the cup paw stays up and out at shoulder width, rock steady in a barista carry so nothing tips. Head low, ears back, eyes locked forward, scarf bunched at the jaw, one tight jet of breath from the corner of his mouth and a crackle of frost crystals ONLY where the palm presses; no pavement, no shadow.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Airborne in a compact arc, belly toward camera, hind legs tucked rather than trailing, free paw thrown forward and the cup paw bent so the cup rides dead level no higher than his ears — not a drop moving, and he knows it. Mouth open in a delighted hup, scarf curling in one short red S behind his shoulder and two beads of breath at the muzzle; nothing trails further than half a body width in any direction.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Free palm and both hind feet slamming down, knees folding deep to absorb it, body low, the cup swung in against his chest with the coffee crested up at the lip and not one drop over. Whiskers forward, eyes wide, scarf flopped up past his cheek, one breath punched out of him, and a tight collar of frost dust bursting right at the paws — the grit touches him, and there is nothing painted on the ground below it.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on to the right in a low fast lope, hind legs at full extension, stubby ringed tail level behind him, cup carried forward and perfectly level in the lead paw like a lantern. Scarf streams back in a curling banner no longer than his own body, breath comes off as three short beads over his shoulder, expression cold-eyed and businesslike — he has somewhere to be and it is thirty-four degrees.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: The same rightward sprint flat out, but the crop held tight: cup pulled hard in against his chest under the free arm (he protects it), scarf curling in one short whipped loop instead of a rigid banner, pale cold-vapour speed streaks only half a body long. Eyes huge, mouth open, breath reduced to three short beads at the muzzle and frost glitter flicking off the heels where they break contact — aspect must not exceed 1.35:1.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: STANDING FRAME, held up to seven seconds: hind feet planted flat and dead still, every hair bristled, cup tipped to his mouth mid-gulp, ears bolt upright, pupils shrunk to pinpricks — the whole animal vibrates without travelling an inch. Baked in: short jitter lines tucked either side of him, a dense pale blush plume no taller than his own head, and two tight vapour rings hugging his shoulders that lift the scarf off his chest.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Standing, cup held high and safely out of traffic in the cup paw while the free paw pulls the scarf end out and open like an apron basket to catch the haul. Gold bottlecaps and fries spiral in tight — the nearest already touching the scarf hem, two ringing off the lid — mouth open and eyes wide with pure astonished delight, a laughing puff of breath; nothing orbits further than half a body width.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Standing under a small folding umbrella in pale slate-blue, canopy half-open and tipped forward into the weather, foreshortened so it is no wider than his shoulders plus a head, held in the free paw with the cup in the other and its steam pooling under the canopy like a small warm room. Sleet beads ice along the rim and bounces off short of the frame edge; chin up, eyes half-lidded, scarf hanging dead still in the dry air — the smuggest raccoon in Seattle.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Hunched and braced at the instant of the hit, knees bent, free paw flung up across his face, the cup hauled into his chest and hugged — he is shielding the coffee, not himself, and nothing spills. A blue-violet dome (never blue-violet) flares tight to his silhouette with a hot white impact ripple where it was struck, sleet skating off it, eyes screwed shut, teeth gritted, scarf blown flat, one shocked plume squeezed out.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Up on his toes, ears flat, head craned back and up at whatever is lining up above him, eyes enormous with the whites showing, free paw clutched to his chest over the scarf fringe and the cup paw out no further than his own shoulder width, still perfectly level. He is holding his breath, so instead of a plume there are two short frozen-vapour exclamation marks sitting within a head's height of his ears and overlapping his silhouette.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting flat out in full panic, mouth wide open, eyes rolled back over his shoulder, hind legs at full stretch, stubby tail straight out, scarf whipping across in front of his own chest rather than out of the cell, cup clutched hard against his ribs. The one frame where the coffee genuinely loses three or four dark drops — painted overlapping his body — with pale blue-white panic streaks half a body long and frost spray only where his heels break contact.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Standing tall on his hind legs, head thrown back, mouth wide open in a shout, free arm punched up but bent so the paw clears his crown by no more than a head, cup raised to eye level in a full toast. Scarf loops up behind him in a short red arc, steam and breath pop together in one dense low burst just above his head with frost sparkles held inside half a body width, and the first low sun of the morning rakes warm across his chest and muzzle — light on the fur, not a painted beam.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back with his legs in the air, scarf fallen loose around his throat and back over his ears, mouth open in a soft ahh, tongue just showing, eyes gone to swooning half-moons with stars circling close above his head. The cup landed upright and leaning against his cheek, lid still on, still gently steaming — the coffee is completely fine and he is not, and he looks quietly proud of that; one last breath plume drifts off sideways.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his haunches and wobbling, spiral eyes, tongue out, ears at two different angles, the scarf wound right around his head by the sweeper brushes so it covers one eye and the fringe hangs over his nose. The cup is still gripped but upside down, the last of the coffee draining in one thin dark thread straight down his own muzzle and chest — no puddle, nothing on the ground — with stars circling above and wobble arcs tucked either side.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst: caught inside a cold blue-white crown of water with cracked skim-ice at its rim, fur plastered flat, free paw flung up, scarf curling wet around his throat inside the crown, eyes wide and mouth a small shocked oh — soaked and clearly out of play, nobody going under. The cup is still held as high as one arm reaches with its lid popped off and one fat icy drop landing in it; keep the crown low and tight so his body mass stays at the centre of the painted content.

firstfrost.left: Must be painted separately — the cup lives in his viewer-RIGHT paw and the scarf fringe hangs down his viewer-LEFT chest, so a mirror swaps both and on an epic skin the coffee visibly changes hands mid-run. garage.block:
Garage Band Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Quadruped at rest on the hero's own skeleton — plantigrade, flat palms down; he rears onto his hind legs only for coffee, magnet, umbrella, shield, scared and cheer, and sits on his haunches for sit, eat and dizzy.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all 18 frames: sleeveless denim vest worn OPEN (never buttoned), deep plum-violet bandana knotted at the throat with the knot off-centre to his left, exactly three enamel pins on the left lapel (pale eye button top, amber sunburst middle, small orange dot bottom), a coiled quarter-inch amp cable over his RIGHT shoulder, and one guitar pick that never leaves him — plus two rationed set pieces, held on the body only: pizza box (eat, magnet) and guitar-case lid (umbrella, shield). The practice amp is CUT from the sheet entirely.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He is the hero's skeleton, so every pose maps one-to-one — but hold Jimothy's body canon: round and spherical, no visible neck, head perched high above the shoulders, long skinny limbs and a SHORT STUBBY tail that never streams, curls out behind or ropes water. Raccoons are PLANTIGRADE: flat palms, five long spread fingers, heel down, in every contact frame — there are no knuckles anywhere on this sheet, that gait belongs to the Sasquatch. The costume must not inflate him: vest shoulders and the cable coil sit tight to the body, and his head must measure the same number of pixels in all eighteen frames, which is the only checkable scale test. Cloth and rope behave — vest hangs open at rest, flares in the air, presses flat in a sprint, goes dark and heavy when soaked; the cable stays a coil, not a trailing line.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing four-square facing camera, all four palms flat and turned slightly out with the fingers spread, weight rocked back, vest hanging open, cable coiled on his right shoulder, pick tucked under the bandana knot. Ears up, brows faintly raised, patient and hopeful — he unlocked the garage twenty minutes ago and nobody has turned up; this is the sheet's quiet frame.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sitting upright on his haunches, back rounded, the whole cable coil resting in his lap with one hind foot hooked through it, stubby tail tucked at his side. Eyes half closed, ears drooped a touch, pick clamped in the corner of his mouth, humming something and still half listening for footsteps at the door.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sitting on his haunches with the open pizza box balanced on his knees and touching his chest, a folded cold slice held up in both flat paws, cheek packed, eyes shut in contentment, pick parked behind his right ear and one short sag of cheese running slice-to-chin. A second slice lies untouched in the box, cut for somebody who never came — nothing on the floor, no plate, no crumbs.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Flattened low on all fours with both palms flat and splayed, haunches up, elbows out, vest bunched around his shoulders, bandana shoved up under his chin, cable coil pulled tight against his back. Eyes locked dead forward, pick gripped crossways in his teeth — the held breath of a count-in before the downbeat.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne and stretched, limbs spread wide with the palms open and fingers splayed, belly forward, denim vest flared off his ribs like two stiff wings, bandana streaming back, stubby tail up. Mouth open in a delighted whoop with the pick parked behind his ear; the cable stays coiled on the shoulder with one short loop of slack, half a body long, curling straight back into the coil.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Both palms slapped FLAT with the fingers splayed and the elbows bent to absorb, body low and compressed, shoulders up around his ears, vest slapping back down against his ribs, one pin still swinging on its clasp. A tight puff of grit bursts off each palm, whiskers and eyes forward, pick behind his ear — a drum hit arriving exactly on the beat.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on sprint to the right, body long and low, plantigrade heels striking, vest streaming back so all three pins turn to camera and the bandana flies horizontal. The cable stays coiled on his right shoulder with a single short whip of slack curling back into it; pick crossways in his teeth, ears laid back.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat out and side-on, legs at maximum stretch, denim pressed flat to him, ears pinned, eyes wide with white showing all round, pick in his teeth. Baked in tight to the body: warm amber amp-glow streaks off his flanks, a few orange sparks off his heels, two small sound-wave rings overlapping his hindquarters, and the coil throwing one short snapping loop of slack — no long line behind him.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: STANDING frame, not a run: reared on his hind legs with both feet planted flat and the whole body vibrating in place, a paper cup gripped in one flat paw, the other paw frozen mid-windmill on an air guitar, jaw clamped on the pick, fur bristled, pupils shrunk to pinpricks. Pale blush-cream steam shivers off the cup, short orange fire licks at both heels and jitter lines hug his outline — he can hear the entire song at once and he is not moving an inch.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Reared on his hind legs holding the empty pizza box open at his chest like a collection plate, mouth open in an astonished laugh, one hind foot lifting as the pull takes him. Gold bottlecaps and two spare picks spiral in on a tight bright-amber ribbon that hugs the box rim — every loose piece overlapping his silhouette — tugging the bandana sideways as they arrive; his own pick stays under the knot.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Reared on his hind legs holding the battered guitar-case lid over him at a three-quarter TILT, no more than about 1.3x his own width, so his face, bandana and one raised brow read clearly underneath and rain sheets off the near edge only. Wordless sticker shapes on the case, smug little line of a mouth, bone dry, cable still coiled on his shoulder and the pick under the knot.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Reared and crouched behind the tilted case lid with both flat palms braced against it, one eye screwed shut, all three pins rattling on the denim as the hit rings the case like a gong. A blue-violet energy dome flares close around him with rain streaking off the curve, one white shock ring and a thin feedback shimmer at the contact point — nothing dark violet, nothing reaching the frame edge.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Reared up on his hind legs, both flat paws clutched to his chest over the vest, ears flat, eyes huge and fixed up-screen, whole body leaning back from whatever is lining him up, bandana flopped half over one eye. The pick has just slipped from his teeth and hangs an inch from his nose, still overlapping his face — it never leaves him.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting to the left, mouth wide open in panic, vest flapping, one flat paw clamped over the bandana knot so he doesn't lose it and the other pinching the pick he snatched back out of the air mid-stride. The cable stays coiled with one short whipping loop of slack, warm orange-red panic streaks come off his heels and two small exclamation marks sit tucked close beside his ear.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Reared tall on his hind legs, head thrown back, mouth open in a joyful whoop, one arm up (elbow bent, so the frame stays square) with the pick pinched glinting between two claws, the other fist punched against his chest, vest thrown wide and bandana snapping. A warm amber amp-glow halo sits close behind his shoulders with three small sound-wave rings and a tight scatter of gold sparks, all inside the idle envelope.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back, all four legs loose in the air with the palms open, vest splayed around him like a burst cushion, bandana over one eye, mouth open in a soundless ow, eyes gone to swooning half-moons — never X's — under a ring of circling yellow stars. All three pins stay on the denim with one swinging on its clasp, the pick spins in the air just above his belly, and one hind foot is still tapping out the four-count, because the set isn't over.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his rump with his legs out in front, wound ankle to shoulder in his own amp cable like a maypole gone wrong, bandana spun round so the knot sits at the back of his neck, stubby tail flat under him. Spiral eyes (spirals belong to dizzy alone — no stars in this frame), tongue out one side, ears pointing two different directions, one pin swinging and the pick stuck flat to his damp forehead.

splash.pose: Caught in the instant of the burst: both flat palms up, soaked through, fur spiked, denim gone dark and heavy, bandana clinging to his throat and the pins dulled to grey, eyes shocked wide and mouth open. A white-and-cream crown of water explodes around his middle with droplets frozen mid-air, and one paw still holds the pick clear above it — the only thing worth saving. He does not sink.

City Pigeon — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Two-legged ground bird: body carried level and forward over two coral feet in every standing frame, never reared upright like a person, and "four-square" never applies to him because he has two feet, not four.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
No costume and no carried kit — the only thing present in all 18 frames is the dried fleck of white crosswalk paint centred across the base of his tail; props appear in exactly three frames (fry cone in eat, takeaway cup in coffee, blown-out umbrella in umbrella) and every one of them touches his body.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He has wings instead of arms and a beak instead of hands, so every raccoon "holding" pose becomes standing IN the container with his head down inside it, and every "arms up" pose becomes a wing throw — wings go up, out and mantled forward over the crown, and never cross the chest, never point, never hold. He has no grip: pigeon feet are weak walking feet, so unlike the crow and the gull he never pins, clamps or tears food — he pecks and swallows whole, and his own body weight is the only thing that ever holds a prop still. He cannot fold onto his haunches, so sit is a settled curb loaf with the feet tucked away underneath, and on his back the two stiff coral feet point straight up. He can technically fly and never does: the hop in leap is the only air he ever gets, and flee is him hammering his wings and still not lifting off — that failure is the character.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: LIVE ART — do not repaint. Both feet planted wide, body level, chest out, head up and cocked so the orange-ringed eye reads to camera; slate wings folded tight with the two black bars showing, green-violet neck sheen catching the streetlight, nothing painted under him. He owns the crosswalk and knows it.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: THE QUIET FRAME. Settled into a full curb loaf, feet folded away out of sight, head sunk so deep between the shoulders he has no neck at all — a warm grey brick with one eye, feathers puffed a size larger against the rain, lids half down and aimed at nothing in particular. The swagger switches off the moment nobody is watching; no concrete, no puddle, no ground.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Standing INSIDE a tipped-over paper cone of fries with both feet, head down in the mouth of it and his own body weight — not a grip — stopping it rolling, one fry crosswise in his beak and the visible eye rolled up at camera mid-theft. Cone completely blank, no printing; nothing scattered on the ground.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: LIVE ART — do not repaint. Body dropped low and horizontal, legs folded deep, feathers slicked flat to the skin, wings unlatched and just cracked open at the shoulders; head thrust forward, eye locked up-screen, tail dropped low. Loaded like a spring, nothing loose, no ground.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: One hop's worth of air: wings only HALF-open with the wrists lifted and the tips no wider than about 1.25x his idle silhouette, breast forward, tail fanned, coral feet trailing curled beneath him, beak open in a delighted coo. Two loose down feathers hang right at his tail, overlapping his body — this is one of only three frames allowed to shed.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: LIVE ART — do not repaint. Wings swept back and cupped hard against the air to brake, tail fanned wide and angled down like a flap, both coral feet stabbing down with the toes splayed, head low and neck feathers blown backward by his own stop. A tight burst of grit and rainwater breaks off the toes and touches them — contact only, no puddle beneath.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on to the right in the flat-out pigeon scurry, wings clamped shut against the body, head thrust forward on a stretched neck mid-bob, one coral foot forward and one back at full stride. Body tipped nose-down, tail up with the white paint fleck centred on it, all business, no flying involved.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: The same scurry absolutely committed: neck at full extension, wings half-cocked out for balance, both feet blurred into a coral smear, crown feathers streaming back. A short spray fan bursts off his own toes and two speed streaks trail off the tail — both stay tight to the body and well clear of the frame edge; no puddle, no ground.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: A STANDING FRAME, held up to 7 seconds: both feet flat and planted, whole body rigid and vibrating, bill sunk into the mouth of a takeaway cup lying on its side against his chest with the lid leaning on its rim — pigeons drink by suction, so the head stays down but the eye clears the rim, enormous with a pinprick pupil, cut straight to camera. Pale blush-cream steam vents around his neck and warm orange jitter licks flicker up his own legs; cup blank, feet never leave the spot, nothing on the ground.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Standing tall on one foot with the other tucked, beak open in an astonished coo and one wing half-raised as if checking whether this is really allowed, eye enormous and shining with pure disbelief. Three gold bottlecaps and a chip arrive in a tight ring that overlaps his chest and wings, nothing further out than half a body width — delight at being chosen, never appetite.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: A full human-sized umbrella, blown out with its ribs folded inward, has come to rest ON him: the crook of the handle hooked over his back between the wings, the shaft lying along his spine, the canopy tipped over his skull like a roof no wider than about 1.3x his own width. He does not look up — chest out, eye to camera, bone dry and entirely smug, with rain skidding off the canopy edge only; no storm drain, no dry circle, no ground.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Braced low with both wings mantled UP and FORWARD over the crown, wrists meeting above the skull into a feathered roof — never crossed in front of the chest — head pulled down between the shoulders, one eye peeking out from under a wing edge, tail splayed for balance. A bright blue-violet dome snaps tight around him with rain streaking off its curve; no shed feathers anywhere.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Frozen rigid, neck periscoped straight up and beak pointed at the sky, one foot still lifted mid-step, neck hackles ruffed out into a collar, the visible eye huge and white-ringed. A gull's wing shadow crosses his chest, neck and one wing and stops dead at his outline — none of it falls on the ground.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting flat out with his wings hammering the air and still not lifting off — that failure is the joke — beak wide open, neck stretched dead ahead, coral feet a blur. Short red speed streaks and two shed feathers trail off his tail, and a small wordless shock burst sits tight above his crown, touching it; no lettering, no punctuation marks.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: HIS FRAME ALONE: up on his toes in a full courting strut with the iridescent neck inflated into a glossy green-violet balloon bigger than his own head, beak open in a triumphant coo, tail fanned and dragging low, wings only slightly out and DOWN — never thrown up into a V. A little confetti of loose down drifts close around his shoulders, overlapping the body.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back with both stiff coral feet straight up and one crossed over the other, wings splayed loose to either side, beak ajar and both eyes shut into blissful half-moons — he reads less knocked out than suspiciously comfortable, like a pigeon sunbathing on purpose. Stars circle his head and a little drizzle drifts through; no X eyes, no shed feathers, no asphalt.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Still up on his own two feet but buckling, one foot crossed over the other mid-stagger, neck gone completely rubbery so the head hangs back upside-down over his shoulders, wings drooping loose at his sides. Spiral swirls where his eyes were and stars orbiting the crown — spirals belong to this frame only; no sweeper bristles, no litter, no shed feathers, no ground.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst: a pale grey-white crown of gutter water explodes around him, wings flung up, beak open, eye bulging with pure personal offence, his soaked neck iridescence running down his front like petrol on a puddle. He stays inside the crown, out of play and deeply insulted — nothing sinks, no ripples, no floating feathers, no ground.

crow.block:
Ballard Crow — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Ground-standing two-legged bird — horizontal body carried level over two scaly feet, three-quarter to camera facing right, hopping rather than walking, wings acting as arms and never as hands; he is never "four-square" and never stands upright like a raccoon.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
No costume and no permanent prop — nothing is worn in any frame; the only constants are black plumage with an oil-slick blue-green sheen, shaggy throat hackles, a cool pale blue-grey rim light down the top and back edge, and the full-saturation gold-amber eye on the camera. Frame-local props exist in exactly six frames and touch his body in every one: the dull gold bottlecap (sit, magnet, dizzy, splash), the paper fry carton (eat), the torn takeaway cup (coffee), the found umbrella (umbrella), the single chip (shield).

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
A crow has no hands, so the bill and one pinning foot do every job Jimothy's paws did — nothing is ever held in a free limb; props are stood on, mantled over, or gripped in the beak. The wings are the arms but they only travel up, out, and forward-mantled over the crown: a wrist may fold across the top of the head, but a wing never crosses the chest, never points, and never carries. The legs bend the bird way — the visible joint is an ankle that folds backward — so he can loaf, squat and fold his feet up beside his own flanks, but he can never stick straight human legs out in front of him. He stands on two feet, so "four-square" applies to no frame on this sheet, and the gold-amber eye finds the camera in all eighteen, including the two where he is on his back.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing squarely on both feet, three-quarter to camera facing right, wings folded tight so the oil-slick blue-green sheen runs across the coverts and the nape hackles sit slightly ruffled. Head level, beak straight out, gold-amber eye locked on the viewer — calm, unhurried, absolutely taking notes; nothing whatsoever painted beneath the feet, not asphalt, not shadow, not grit.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sunk into a loaf on nothing at all: feet vanished up under the belly feathers, body one rounded black cushion, neck gone into the shoulders, rain beading and running off his back. Sheltered under his own breast is a single dull gold bottlecap he is keeping dry — his entire fortune — and one half-lidded gold eye still finds the camera. This is the quiet, sad frame of the sheet.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Head cranked low over a spilled paper fry carton with one scaly foot planted flat on top of it, pinning it the way crows actually do, three fries already jammed crosswise in the bill while he tugs a fourth free. Every loose fry stays touching the carton mouth or his own toes — none scattered on the ground — and one gold eye rolls up to the camera, daring you to come closer.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Body dropped horizontal over deeply flexed legs, plumage slicked tight so the silhouette narrows to a loaded dart, tail angled down, wings cracked open a hand's width at the wrists. Head thrust forward and low, beak level, eye wide and fixed dead ahead: all spring, no lift yet.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Airborne and climbing, wings beating down and forward in a tight half-spread with the primaries fanned but the whole span held inside about 1.4x his body height, feet folded back under the tail. Chest thrown toward the camera, beak slightly parted, gold eye on the viewer — no trailing feather, no spray, nothing left behind him.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Wings cupped hard forward to brake with the tail fanned wide beneath as an airbrake, both feet thrown out ahead and the toes spread to grab. Head already coming back up and the eye forward on the next row, with a small tight crown of water droplets bursting right at the toes — contact spray touching the feet only, no puddle and no cast shadow under him.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Mid two-footed side-hop travelling right, both feet together and just clear, body low and level, wings tucked but flicked half-open at the wrists for balance with the tail flared to steer. Head stays square to the camera even as the body travels sideways — cocky, watching you the whole way across; nothing asymmetric anywhere in the frame so this one mirrors cleanly.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: A grounded full-tilt bounding scramble — both feet slapping forward together, wings hammering a hard downbeat that half-lifts him and never quite gets him up, body stretched long and level, tail flared for steering. He does NOT fly: the joke is a city crow too heavy with chips to get airborne, so wings stay short of full extension, spray is two small bursts at the wingtips and feet, and streaks run no longer than half his body.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: Feet planted and going absolutely nowhere, one foot clamped on the rim of a torn-open takeaway cup tipped in against his chest, bill up, beak parted, wired to the eyeballs and holding still. Every feather bristled, hackles standing straight up, pupil pinned to a black dot inside the gold iris, jitter lines shivering off the whole body and pale blush-cream steam curling tight off the cup — warm cream, never pink.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Wings tented forward and down in the full crow mantle, but the face is pure astonishment — beak wide in a delighted caw, both gold eyes huge, head lifted: things are coming TO him and he cannot believe his luck. Fries and gold bottlecaps arrive in a close ring that overlaps his wings and body, on warm gold-cream trails no longer than half a body width; nothing streaks in from off past the edges.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Standing bone dry and deeply smug on one foot with the other tucked up into the belly, feathers perfectly smooth, under a blown-out found umbrella whose bent ribs lean against his own shoulder — the prop touches him, and there is no curb and no ground anywhere. Canopy tilted low and back so his body stays the centre of mass, faded teal-and-ochre fabric (never pink), rain running off the rim in short strings well inside the frame, head tilted at the camera: yes, this is mine now.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: One wing hooked up and over the crown as a roof of feathers while the OTHER stays mantled down over a single chip he flatly refuses to abandon — this is the crow's own solve, never the two-wings-over-the-face the other birds use. A bright blue-violet dome flares tight around him with rain streaking off the curve, two or three loose black feathers knocked free and hanging over his own outline, one gold eye glaring out from under the wrist; feet braced, no skid marks, no road.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Crouched low with the head cranked straight up at the sky, beak wide open in an alarm caw, nape and throat hackles flared into a spiky ruff. Wings half-lifted off the body ready to bail, tail clamped hard down, both eyes huge — a crow being bullied by a bird with worse manners.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Panicked half-flying scramble travelling left: feet still pedalling, wings beating badly out of sync, body tipped forward past its own balance, beak open mid-caw. Warm red-orange speed streaks kept to half his body length behind him and a thin trail of three or four shed black feathers overlapping his own outline — no floating symbols, no exclamation marks, no lettering of any kind.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Head thrown all the way back, chest arched forward, beak wide in a rattling caw with the shaggy throat hackles flared out into a beard — the crow's own cheer, not the gull's shriek and not the pigeon's balloon. Both wings go UP but crooked hard at the wrist so the tips stay inside about 1.15x his idle height, tail fanned, one foot lifted in a little hop, and two loose feathers popping free BELOW the wingtips so nothing adds height.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: On his back and rolled slightly toward the camera, legs bent with both tarsi folded to one side and the toes curled loose in the air, one wing flopped up across his own face because he cannot bear to be seen like this. The other wing lies limp on the near side, beak open, and one gold eye peeks out from under the wrist while pale stars circle the head — dazed and mortified, wounded pride only; no X eyes, no spirals, no loose feathers.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sat back on his rump with both legs bent the bird way — tarsi folded so the feet come back up beside his own flanks, toes curled loose, knees buried in the belly feathers — and both wings drooping off the shoulders like empty sleeves. Head lolling onto one shoulder, beak hanging open, gold eyes spiralled, and three tiny gold bottlecaps wobbling in a close orbit around his head instead of stars; no wing over the face, no loose feathers.

splash.pose: Caught in the instant of the burst — a white and pale-blue crown of water exploding up around him, wings out and up in an appalled shrug, beak wide, both gold eyes outraged, soaked to half his own width with the feathers plastered to a scrawny pencil neck and knobbly bare legs. One gold bottlecap is still pinched in the tip of his bill, because the water got the bird but not the treasure; he is inside the burst and never under it, and nothing sinks.
