seagull.block:
Seagull — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Bipedal bird: upright on two pale-orange webbed feet at rest, never on all fours — "four-square" is a quadruped word and does not apply to him in any frame.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
No clothing at all — his costume is ONE stolen french fry: crosswise in the yellow bill in idle, sit, eat (mid-swallow), crouch, land, run-r, dash-run, shield and dizzy; pinned under his LEFT webbed foot in coffee, umbrella and magnet; detached but still overlapping him in cheer (tossed), scared (falling), ko (lying by his bill) and splash (streaming off); absent ONLY from leap, deliberately. Other props, all completely BLANK — no logo, letters or numbers, ever: a red-and-white fry carton (eat, magnet, flee, splash), a plain black umbrella (umbrella), a plain takeaway cup (coffee).

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He has no hands, so every raccoon "hold" is re-solved three ways: the bill grips, a webbed foot pins, and anything too big to grip is bitten high on the shaft so it rests on the body. Wing arc is strict — up, out and forward-mantled over the crown only; a wing never crosses in front of the chest, never points, never holds and never props him up. He stands on two legs, so rest is a one-legged hunch or a folded crouch, never a lap and never all fours. Body lock from the four existing PNGs: tall and narrow beside Jimothy's sphere, slate mantle, black wingtips with white mirrors, yellow bill with the red gonys spot, pale-orange webbed feet, short stubby tail, dark eye — same head size in all eighteen frames.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing square on both pale-orange webbed feet, wings folded tight with the black primaries crossed over the stubby tail, neck drawn in against the drizzle. One stolen fry clamped crosswise in the yellow bill, dark eye locked dead on camera with absolutely no guilt in it — and no pavement under him.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: The gull's own rest, not a loaf: up on ONE leg with the other foot drawn into his breast feathers, body hunched, rain beading along the mantle, eye half-lidded and looking at nothing in particular. The fry is still crosswise in his bill, unstarted — he is not eating it because when it is gone the day is over.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: One webbed foot planted flat on the tipped blank carton, head thrown all the way back over his spine, bill wide, a whole fry going down vertically with the throat visibly bulging. Wings cracked a few inches for balance and one eye rolled down at the viewer mid-swallow — caught, and entirely unbothered; nothing scattered loose off the body.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Compressed low and forward, tarsi folded, breast almost down to his own toes, wings cracked open a few inches to unlock, tail cocked, neck thrust out and eye fixed far ahead. Fry still crosswise in the bill, with a first flick of grit and water kicking off the webbed toes and staying tight to the feet.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: A WIDE, slightly swept glide-dive: span held horizontal and angled forward with the wrists swept back so the whole shape sits about 1.3 wide to 1 tall, body and head large and unmistakable dead centre, bill level, feet tucked back. Absolutely nothing carried, no shed feathers, no spray — this same PNG is the diving-gull hazard at 69px and mirrors by direction, so it must read as one clean incoming bird and carry nothing shaped like a pickup.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Feet thrown forward with the webbed toes splayed wide, wings cupped forward to air-brake, tail fanned down like a flap, head coming back up as the weight settles — and the fry still in his bill, which is the whole joke. A tight white-and-cyan burst bites up around his own feet only: no puddle, no ring on the floor, no pavement.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on to the right in the ridiculous flat-out gull waddle-run: body horizontal, neck stretched forward like an arrow, both wings half-open for balance, orange feet a paddling blur, fry trailing horizontally from the bill. Deliberately symmetric — nothing side-specific in this frame, because the engine mirrors it to make run-l.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: The same waddle at absolute maximum, wings caught at the bottom of a full power-stroke and STILL not airborne — the bird who could just fly and somehow never does — feet skimming, eye wide, pupil a pinprick, fry pinned flat back along his cheek by the wind. Three short white speed streaks, a low spray off the heels and two shed down feathers, all held inside the idle box.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: Feet planted and holding perfectly still while everything else vibrates: the takeaway cup pinched by its rim in his bill and tipped fully upside down, lid popped, the lot going down in one. Crown feathers straight up in a startled crest, pupil shrunk to a dot, pale blush-cream steam (never pink), short orange fire licks and jitter ticks right at his feet — and the fry pinned under his left foot even now.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Head back, bill wide in a delighted open-billed scream, wings half-raised and cupped forward as if gathering it all in, every feather fluffed with sheer astonishment — the best day of his life. Fries, gold bottlecaps and one small tumbling carton spiral in TIGHT, every piece overlapping his silhouette and none more than half a body width out; the fry stays pinned under his left foot.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: A cheap black umbrella bitten by the SHAFT high up, just under the canopy, so it roofs his skull like a hat with the handle dangling loose past his breast and rain sheeting off the rim in a short curtain that never leaves the canopy. Bone dry, wings folded, eye half-lidded and insufferably smug, fry pinned under his left foot because the bill is busy — nothing jammed into a grate, nothing on the floor.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: His own solve and no other bird's: turned side-on into the weather with one shoulder driven straight into the blast, wings clamped hard to the body, head low, feet braced, fry held dead level in the bill and completely unmoved. A blue-violet dome flares around him with a hot white spot where the hit landed and rain raking off it — never violet, never dark.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Even gulls have a gull: the hard-edged shadow of a much bigger, meaner one falls across his back, breast and half his face, painted only where it lands on his body. Neck fully periscoped, bill open in a squawk of pure indignation, eyes rolled up, wings half-lifted and shivering — and the fry has finally slipped, caught mid-fall an inch below his bill with one sharp exclamation tick beside his head.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Full panic sprint to the left, body low and horizontal, neck stretched, both wings hammering, webbed feet a blur — with the ENTIRE blank red-and-white carton clamped in his bill, because he grabbed the whole thing on the way out. Red-orange speed streaks and one or two shed feathers rake off his tail, kept tight to the body.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: The gull long call, which belongs to him alone: chest thrown out, head thrown right back over the spine, bill wide in a full-throated shriek at the rain, wings held low and slightly out — never a raised V, that is the other birds. One fry flips end over end just above his crown and overlapping his head, a few chip fragments falling close beside him, warm gold rim-light on his outline instead of a background sunbreak.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Down on his right side, right wing pinned under him, left flopped over his flank, both legs out together with the toes curled, bill hanging open. Eyes are swooning half-moon lids with small gold stars circling tight above his head, and the fry lies one beak-length from that open bill, uneaten — he went out reaching for it.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Folded down onto his rump with both legs splayed out in front like a dropped toy, wings limp at his sides, head lolling back, little pink tongue out and spiral eyes (spirals are dizzy's alone — no stars in this frame). The fry hangs half out of the drooping bill by one end, a wobble arc either side of his head, and the whole silhouette is deliberately nothing like ko's.

splash.pose: Swept hard sideways by the burst: a bright blue-violet crown explodes at his chest and shoves him off downstream, body angled with the flow, one wing braced uselessly against it and the other thrown up, soaked through, eye locked on camera and deeply offended. The blank carton tumbles away just ahead of his bill with two fries in the spray, everything still overlapping him and clear of the frame edge — no water surface, no kerb, no grate anywhere.

opossum.block:
Opossum — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Quadruped: four-square at rest on flat plantigrade paws, heel down and five long spread fingers, and he only frees his forepaws by sitting back onto his rump — never by standing upright like a person.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all eighteen frames: a faded orange hi-vis night-crew vest, always on and hanging open, two silver reflective bands with the lower one peeling on his LEFT side; a blank unlettered laminated badge on a lanyard on his LEFT chest; a dented steel thermos clipped to the vest on a short cord at his RIGHT hip. Nothing else, and nothing ever comes off.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
The prehensile tail is his spare hand and it does every job Jimothy does with a free paw, but it is anchored at the rump and only about body-length: sat back, it can reach forward between his hind feet to his own chest, or run up his spine to just behind his ears — it can never hold anything over the head of a stretched-out quadruped. Like the raccoon he is plantigrade: flat palms, five spread fingers, heel down, opposable rear thumb on the hind foot; no knuckle-walking anywhere. Reared frames sit back on the rump with both hind feet flat, which frees both forepaws honestly and keeps the tail free as a third hand rather than a fifth leg. His head must be the same pixel size in all eighteen frames, so the reared frames have to reach the same head height as the four-square ones.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Three-quarter quadruped foreshortened toward the camera so he stays taller than wide, four-square on flat palms, pale pointed face, pink nose, black bead eyes, nicked left ear. Tail curled under and around beside him in a tight S that touches his flank the whole way; vest hanging open with the peeling band on his left, blank badge swinging on its lanyard, thermos clipped at his right hip.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sat back on his rump, hind feet flat, forepaws folded on his belly, ears down and eyelids at half mast, looking at nothing at the end of the shift. Tail coiled beside him in a flat spiral resting against his own foot, vest slumped open, badge hanging dead still, the dented thermos tipped empty against his thigh.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sat back on his rump with a to-go tub of cold clam chowder brought up to his chest by the tail, which comes forward between his hind feet and wraps the tub twice. Both forepaws work a little plastic fork, cheeks packed, eyes squeezed shut with contentment, a chowder smear on his chin and one oyster cracker balanced on the blank badge; thermos at his hip.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Flattened right down on all fours, staged three-quarter and foreshortened toward the camera so the box stays tall, elbows out, haunches up, nicked ear pinned flat, eyes locked dead forward past the viewer. Tail swept around beside him in a shallow arc touching his flank rather than trailing straight back, vest bunched over his shoulders, thermos pressed flat to his ribs.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne, all four legs splayed wide, pale belly turned to the viewer, mouth open in a delighted little gape. Tail whipped into a full loop that stays inside his own silhouette, thick and fully opaque with the tip tucked back toward his hip and never thinning to a wisp; vest ridden up around his ribs, badge and thermos flung out on their cords but still overlapping his body.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Front paws planted flat, spine bowed, hindquarters still dropping, whiskers thrown forward, eyes wide with the impact. His tail slaps down and throws a tight spray fan that touches only his tail and paws — no puddle and no road under him — while the reflective bands buckle across his chest and the thermos bounces off the vest.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on bounding gallop to the right showing his RIGHT flank, body stretched long but head lifted and the tail curled up in an arc over his rump rather than streaming back, so the frame stays taller than wide. Hind feet gathered under him with the rear thumb splayed, thermos swinging forward on its cord, the badge swung across from his far side and blank on both faces.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat-out four-legged bound, legs at maximum stretch and still visibly not very fast, eyes huge and ears back. Exactly one trailing element: a single short arc of coffee no longer than his own tail, curving up into the box from the popped thermos cap still dangling on its cord — plus two small fire licks under his belly and nothing else behind him.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: A STANDING frame, held up to seven seconds: sat back on his rump with both hind feet planted flat and absolutely still, wired to the eyeballs, tail brought up to grip the dented thermos upright while both forepaws clamp the little screw-cap cup at his chin. Pinprick pupils, fur bristled along his spine, whiskers in tight jitter arcs, steam painted pale blush-cream and never pink, two fire licks at his planted feet.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Sat back on his rump with the tail brought forward between his hind feet and curled into a scoop at his chest, already heaped with gold bottlecaps, mouth open and eyes round with astonishment that things are coming TO him. A tight inward spiral of more caps and stray fries curls in close around his shoulders, every one overlapping his silhouette and none near the frame edge; vest pockets brimming.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Sat back on his haunches so tail root and skull are close together, the tail running up his own spine to hook a small black umbrella just behind his ears with the canopy tipped FORWARD, so the dry zone covers his head and chest and his tail root is the wet bit. Both forepaws free and deeply smug — one tucked in the vest pocket, one cradling the thermos — blank badge hanging dry against his chest, rain sheeting off the canopy edges in short strokes that stop well inside the margin and never reach the ground.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: The flinch: crouched low with both forepaws crossed over his face and one black eye squinting through the gap, tail clamped tight around his own ankle. A bright blue-violet dome — never violet — flares white at the point of impact just clear of his back, and inside it the reflective bands are the brightest thing on him, the blank badge flipped up and hanging on its lanyard, thermos swung out against the vest.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Reared back on his rump with the enormous opossum gape cranked wide open — teeth rounded off, no drool, no snarl — eyes rolled up and back with the whites showing in pure panic. Fur puffed out, forepaws clutched tight to his chest, tail stiff and curved up close behind his back, badge flipped up and stuck in his chin fur clear of his face; his scariest face is an obvious bluff and everyone can tell.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting left with everything he has, legs blurred into a scribble, mouth open in a panicked wail, vest flapping with the thermos and blank badge swinging wild. Two short red speed streaks and two fat exclamation marks sit close behind his shoulders overlapping his body — no skid mark, no ground, nothing touching the edge.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Reared up tall on his rump with both forepaws punched skyward but bent at the elbow so they stay inside the box, tail thrown into a triumphant question-mark curl beside his head rather than above it, mouth wide in the same huge gape — joyful this time. Reflective bands blazing, badge swinging, a low tight arc of gold bottlecaps around his shoulders, none of them near the frame edge.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Playing dead and badly overselling it: flopped on his side with the spine curled into a compact C, legs stiff and curled in the air, tongue lolled out over his teeth, tail curled up over his flank, one eye squeezed shut and the other cracked open a slit peeking straight at the viewer. Stars circle his head and two small green stink curls rise tight off his flank; vest twisted up under his shoulders with one band catching the streetlight, blank badge lying face up beside his ear on its lanyard, thermos rolled to a stop against his back.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: On his back, all four feet up in the air, tail flopped in a loose corkscrew across his own chest, vest twisted around backwards with one reflective band still showing. Spiral eyes and tongue flopped sideways, wet leaves and brush bristles stuck ON him — snagged in the vest, caught in the tail, one draped over his snout — with two more circling his head in place of stars; this is the one time he genuinely was not faking it.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst: soaked through with his fur plastered flat so he looks half his usual size, forepaws thrown up, mouth open in a shocked gape, tail hanging like a wet rope against his leg. A white and pale-cyan crown of water explodes around his middle with the droplets kept well inside the margin, and the vest is a sodden dark orange rag with both bands still showing — he is startled, not going anywhere under the surface.

soggy.block:
Soggy Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Hunched quadruped raccoon: four-square on all fours at rest and in every travel frame, rearing back onto his hind legs (tripod, stubby tail counterweighting) for any frame that needs a free forepaw — never a full human upright.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
ALL 18 FRAMES: the folded newspaper hat (fold points to his right; print is fine grey column TEXTURE, never a legible word) plus a live drip line coming off him somewhere. Per-frame props, and nothing else ever: soggy cardboard fry tray (eat, magnet), takeaway cup (coffee), crook-handled umbrella (umbrella).

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
Jimothy's own body under the water: round and spherical, no visible neck, head perched high on the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a STUBBY ringed tail that hangs or holds short — it never streams, never flicks a rope of water and never fans a wake. He is plantigrade in every single frame including both runs, the leap and the landing: flat palms, five long spread fingers, heel down, never a knuckle. Standing rules: he is four-square only when nothing is in his paws, and the instant a prop appears he is up on his hind legs — no frame gets a fifth limb. Soaked-fur clumping and the hat's slump state are the only things allowed to change across the sheet; his height, head size and silhouette mass are identical in all 18.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing four-square facing camera exactly as the existing master, weight even, soaked fur clumped into dark dripping spikes, the newspaper hat still holding its crisp fold. A small contented smile while drips hang and fall from his chin, elbows and hat brim — no puddle, no wet mark, nothing at all under his paws.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sitting up on his haunches, forepaws folded on a soaked belly, water still wringing out of his chest fur in one thin steady thread. The hat has slumped a quarter turn so the brim rests across one eyebrow and he doesn't fix it — he just watches the rain over the camera's shoulder, content and a little alone. This is the quiet frame. No puddle beneath him.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sitting with a rain-collapsed cardboard fry tray wedged against his shin and belly so it physically touches him, holding one fry up in both flat forepaws; it has gone so soft it folds double before it reaches his mouth and he watches it bend with genuine admiration. A thin stream drools off the hat brim straight down into the tray, topping it back up.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Flattened low on all fours as in the existing master, haunches up, elbows out, coiled to spring, water sheeting off his back and shedding down his flanks in short runnels that stay on the fur. The hat has slid forward into a wet paper visor and he peers out from under it, eyes locked up-screen; nothing pools between his paws.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne, limbs spread wide, flat palms open, belly forward and delighted, throwing a tight fan of droplets off his fur that stays inside the reach of his own limbs. Stubby ringed tail short and straight behind him; the hat has lifted a finger's width off his skull by one corner, still attached by sheer sogginess.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Front paws slammed flat, body low, spine compressed, whiskers forward, a contact crown of splash bursting up around all four feet and rising no higher than his knees. The hat drops back onto his brow with a fresh slap of water off the brim; his eyes are wide and pleased.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on sprint to the right, body low, legs at full extension, flat palms reaching, stubby ringed tail held short and level with two or three beads flicking off its tip — no rope, no wrung-mop trail. The hat streams back tight against his skull with one corner unfolded into a short curled ribbon flapping against his ear; hat print is grey column texture only.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat-out sprint, legs at maximum stretch, eyes wide, no fire on this one — a short dirty rooster tail of gutter water breaks off his heels and dies within half a body width, and the rain flashes into thin white steam off his shoulders where he is moving too fast for it to land. The hat is pinned flat to his skull, its column texture stretched taut.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: STANDING STILL and vibrating: reared on his hind legs, both feet planted, both forepaws clamped around a takeaway cup the rain has already refilled past the lid, pupils shrunk to pinpricks, soaked fur bristled into spikes. Pale blush-cream steam off the cup, short jitter lines either side of him and a couple of warm orange fire licks tight at his feet — even the drip hanging off his chin is vibrating.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Reared up hugging the rain-collapsed fry tray to his chest, mouth open, eyes bright with pure astonishment that for once things are coming TO him. Gold bottlecaps spiral in on a warm amber ribbon that stays within half a body width and overlaps his shoulder, and the wet hat's ink has begun to run — one dark blue-black streak painting down his cheek like a happy tear.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Reared on his hind legs, one flat forepaw gripping the crook of an open umbrella held close over his skull, rain hammering the canopy and shedding off both edges in short curtains no wider than the canopy itself. He is still wringing wet and still dripping, but the hat is gently steaming as it finally begins to dry and his smile is quiet and enormously smug — no puddle, no dry patch of ground.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: The instant of impact: crouched low, forepaws thrown up flat-palmed, eyes squeezed shut, chin tucked — and just as soaked as every other frame, same dark dripping fur spikes, same sagging hat, nothing dries. A bright blue-violet dome snaps up tight around him with rain shattering off the outside, while the water it knocks loose hangs inside the dome as a rimlit burst of droplets and a hard blue-white edge light runs the length of his near side.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Reared on his hind legs, both forepaws clutched to his chest, ears flat back, eyes enormous and fixed on something above the frame; the hat brim has flopped up on its own, so the full downpour is now hitting him square in the face. Water runs into his open, worried mouth and he does not move to stop it.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting left flat out, mouth open in panic, two small red '!!' strokes stamped in the air right beside his ear and overlapping his head, a short tight burst of filthy gutter spray off his heels. The hat has torn half off and is pinned by one soaked corner against his shoulder rather than trailing — and even now the corner of his mouth is still trying to smile.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Reared tall on his hind legs, one arm punched to the sky, mouth open in a shout of pure joy; the newspaper hat has just left his fingertips and spins at head height, overlapping his raised paw, its droplet halo kept inside the hat's own arc. Underneath, the revealed head fur is a flattened, comically wet little dome.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back, all four legs up with flat pads to the sky and the drips now running off his upturned palms, a ring of gold stars circling his head and swooning half-moon lids on the eye that shows. The hat has landed over his face like a little pitched paper roof, headline band up and brim tented off his nose, one dazed happy eye peeking through a torn column — quietly pleased to finally be lying down. Nothing spreads beneath him.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his side, spiral eyes, tongue lolling, stars orbiting his head, the hat spun down over one ear at a drunk angle. Ink from the soaked newsprint runs down both cheeks in two long dark blue-black spiral smears that match his eyes exactly, and a last fat drip swings off his ear.

splash.pose: Caught in the burst: arms thrown straight up, flat palms spread, eyes bulging, mouth wide in shock as a crown of pale blue-white water erupts around him and blows him backwards — nothing sinking, nothing going under. The hat has finally given up and gone to warm-grey pulp, sliding down his brow in soft ribbons, and under it he is unmistakably still smiling. Wettest he has ever been.

summer.block:
Hot Jimothy Summer — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Quadruped raccoon, plantigrade — flat palms, five long spread fingers, heels down, four-square at rest; he rears onto his haunches ONLY in the six frames that say so (coffee, magnet, umbrella, shield, scared, cheer).

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all eighteen frames, no exceptions: the oversized orange-and-cream striped life ring (rope trim, visible valve stem, teal patch repeated on BOTH flanks at the same height) and the orange-framed dark shades. Everything else — popsicle, slush cup, iced coffee, parasol, towel — is a per-frame prop.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
This is Jimothy's own body, so every hero pose maps one-to-one, but hold the canon: round and spherical, no visible neck, head perched high on the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a SHORT STUBBY ringed tail that never streams, curls out behind or trails — strike every "streaming tail" from the old draft. Hands are plantigrade raccoon hands, flat palms and spread fingers with the heel down, in every frame including cheer and coffee; no knuckles, no tiptoe. The ring is a rigid torus and never a flat ellipse — highlight along the top curve, shadow tucked under the bottom, valve stem findable — painted at ONE constant outer diameter (about 1.4x his shoulder width, inner hole clearly wider than his shoulders) in all eighteen, so only its position and tilt ever change; if it must read smaller, tilt it into foreshortening, never shrink it. That deliberate oversize is what makes the costume honest: it rests on his barrel at idle only because his stance cocks it there, which is why it can then slide to the armpits, collar the neck, and drop clean to his ankles without him appearing to change size.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing four-square three-quarter to camera, weight cocked onto one hip so the oversized ring hangs tilted around his barrel — front edge low, back edge caught on the slope of his shoulders, no paw needed to hold it. Chin lifted, mouth a small satisfied line, shades dead level, one fat drizzle bead sliding down the left lens.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: The quiet frame: he has sat straight down through the ring so it collars his hips like a donut chair, hind feet out over the front rim, flat palms folded on the top curve, head tipped back at a sky that is plainly not going to clear. Shades on, contented half-smile going soft at the corners, drizzle beading along the rubber.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Still seated in the ring, leaning on its top curve like a table — a paper cup of blue slush wedged against the rim at his side, a half-melted orange popsicle held up in both flat palms. He is licking a drip off his own wrist, shades on, while the rain melts it faster than any sun would have.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Repaint: coiled low and forward, shoulders down, haunches up, palms and heels flat — the same full-diameter ring has slid up to collar his neck, tipped steeply so it foreshortens into an oval instead of shrinking, squashing his cheeks out either side. Eyes forward over the top of the rubber, shades knocked one degree crooked.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne, belly forward, mouth open in a whoop — limbs gathered inside the box rather than stretched flat, forepaws reaching and hind feet trailing close. The ring has ridden up to his armpits and rides the air with him, shades perfectly level, a short arc of water beads flicking off its trailing edge and still touching it.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Front palms slapped down flat with the fingers spread, body low and absorbing, as the ring bounces up and clouts him under the chin, shoving cheeks and whiskers forward. Shades jolted one notch down his snout so a single wide eye peeks over the top rim, and a small white splash crown bursts right at his paws, touching them — nothing else below him.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on sprint to the right, body low, forelegs reaching and hind heels coming down through the stride, the stubby ringed tail short and level behind him. The ring is squashed against his ribs with two short wobble lines off its edge and one flat palm clamped on the rim holding it down; paint the teal patch on this flank exactly as on the far side so the mirror is invisible.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat out and lower still, tongue out, ears back, the ring shoved into a slipstream cone against his shoulders. Three short orange speed streaks along his flanks, a white glint flashing across both lenses, and a tight fan of spray bursting off his hind paws and attached to them — no rooster tail, no puddle, no street.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: He is NOT moving: reared onto his haunches with both hind feet planted flat and heels down, vibrating on the spot, both palms clamped around an enormous iced coffee with a bendy straw, ice cubes jumping just clear of the lid. Shades pushed up on his forehead — two enormous jittering pinprick pupils — with jitter lines and a motion-blur double edge held tight against the ring.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Reared up on his haunches, arms flung wide, mouth open in astonished delight as gold bottlecaps and stray fries spiral in tight around the ring — a couple pinging off the taut rubber, one already lodged in the rope trim. Two little gold streaks reflected in the dark lenses; every loose cap sits within half a body width and overlaps his silhouette.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Reared up and immovably smug: a candy-striped beach parasol gripped in one palm and leaned back against his shoulder, canopy no wider than about 1.3x him, other palm planted on his hip, ring level at his waist. A beach towel is draped over both shoulders with the ends hanging even on each side, and rain drums on the canopy and flicks off the rim in short streaks that die in mid-air — no sidewalk, no crack, nothing under him.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Braced sideways into the hit, parasol tilted across like a shield, both palms up, inside a blue-violet faceted dome that hugs his silhouette no more than a hand's width out — never blue-violet, the knockout eats that. Rain skids off it in hard short diagonals, the ring squashes flat on the impact side, shades jolt crooked, whiskers swept back, muzzle scrunched in a flinch.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Reared onto his hind legs with the ring hauled off his body and hugged to his chest in both arms, exactly like the life preserver it always was, head craned up and back. Shades slid to the very tip of his snout so two huge white eyes stare over the top, mouth a tiny o, and a hard wedge of gull shadow falls across his chest and the rubber.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting flat toward camera-left, mouth wide, ears pinned, the licked-bare popsicle stick still clenched in his teeth — nothing thrown, nothing tumbling loose in the air. The ring has flapped up around his neck like a horse collar, three short red streaks come off his heels, and one lens catches a hard slash of the sweeper's yellow light.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Up on his hind legs with heels down, stretched as tall as he goes, both arms punched up and the ring hoisted just over his head — tilted hard toward camera so it foreshortens into an ellipse instead of adding height. Mouth open in pure joy; the one real sunlight on the whole sheet, painted onto him as a warm gold rim-light down his fur and two sparks on the lenses, no beam and no shaft.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back, all four legs in the air with the palms flopped open, rocking gently on the ring like a turtle on its shell and suspiciously comfortable about it. Shades sit crooked with one lens popped out and resting on his chest fur — through the empty rim, one dazed swooning half-moon eye — tongue lolling, small stars circling tight around his head.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his side, cheeks puffed, mouth in a woozy wobble, with spirals painted straight onto both dark lenses because the shades never came off. The ring is still on him at full diameter, dented soft where his shoulder pins it, a thin pale curl of air whistling from the valve, one hind paw twitching — spirals only here, stars belong to ko.

splash.pose: Sat down hard in about six inches of water, arms straight up, fur plastered flat, mouth open in betrayed shock as a big white crown of water bursts around his hips and shoulders — no flat pool, no ripple rings, nothing detached. Shades shoved up on his dripping forehead so you can see exactly how personally he is taking this, and the ring has dropped clean around his ankles like a fallen hula hoop with water blowing up through the hole. He is not going under; he has been humiliated by a puddle.

nordic.block:
Nordic Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Quadruped: at rest he stands four-square on four flat plantigrade paws, and any frame that needs a hand rears him fully up onto his hind legs — never four-square while holding something, never a half-measure tripod.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all 18 frames, exactly two things: the heavy navy fair-isle sweater (cream/red/white horizontal bands with pale-blue flecks, ribbed cuffs ending at the WRIST, ribbed hem to mid-thigh) and the navy knit bobble hat with its red-and-cream band and oversized oatmeal pom — the fries carton (eat), takeaway cup (coffee) and umbrella (umbrella) each appear in one frame only and stay gripped on the body.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
Nordic is Jimothy's own body, so every pose transfers one to one: round and spherical, no visible neck, head perched high on the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a STUBBY ringed tail — never a long streaming trash-panda tail, in any of the eighteen. He is plantigrade: flat palms, five long spread fingers, heels down, and the ribbed cuffs stop at the wrist so the bare dark paws and the short tail below the hem stay readable in every frame (this overrides the old "sleeves swallow his forepaws / every prop handled through a cuff" note, which contradicts all four shipped frames — he grips with bare hands). The sweater is a second body that lags a beat behind him and the pom is the lag weight that sells the timing, but the wool never becomes his hands; the one exception is coffee, where he tugs the cuffs down over his palms as pot-holders with the fingertips still showing. Standing rules a painter must not break: no frame is four-square and holding a prop, the hem never drags on a floor because there is no floor, and the pom never leaves clear margin at the top of the cell.

barista.block:
Barista Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Upright bipedal in all 18 — plantigrade with flat palms, five long spread fingers and heels flat down, he stands, crouches, leaps, lands, runs and flees on his hind feet only; he is never four-square and never knuckle-walks.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In every single frame: the green apron with leather shoulder straps crossing LEFT over RIGHT and a brown patch pocket, one kraft-sleeved takeaway cup with a plain white lid that lives either in the RIGHT paw or stowed upright in that pocket, and a stub of pencil behind the LEFT ear — no other props ever, no tray, no lettering or logo on anything (the coffee frame is the one licensed exception: a second identical cup in the left paw).

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He is hero Jimothy's body in an apron: round and spherical with no visible neck, the head perched high above the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a STUBBY tail that never streams, curls out behind or flicks a rope of water — it is a short stub in all eighteen frames. Because the stance lock is upright, the poses originally designed as three-point quadruped scrambles become two-foot squats, two-foot jumps and a hind-leg sprint, with the stubby tail and the free left arm doing all the counterweighting. The cup permanently occupies his right hand, so any pose that needs both hands stows it upright in the apron pocket — it never goes on the ground, because there is no ground. Hands and feet stay plantigrade in every frame: flat palms, spread fingers, heels down, never knuckles.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time

The cup is balanced improbably upright on the crown of his skull, gently steaming, which somehow makes it worse.

fishmonger.block:
Fishmonger Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Plantigrade quadruped at rest — four-square on flat palms and heels-down hind feet with the stubby tail low; he rears onto his haunches or hind legs ONLY in sit, eat, coffee, magnet, scared and cheer, and never knuckle-walks.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all 18 frames, no exceptions: the slate-blue waxed bib apron (neck strap over the head, waist ties knotted at the back, one patch pocket low on his RIGHT side, ragged wet hem, zero lettering) and the whole silver market salmon — carried three ways only, clamped crosswise in the jaws, cradled across both flat palms, or laid across his lap or chest.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
This is Jimothy's own body, so every hero pose transfers one for one: round and spherical with no visible neck, head perched high above the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a STUBBY ringed tail that never streams, curls out behind him or flicks a rope of water. He is plantigrade — flat palms, five long spread fingers, heel down — never knuckles. The one real constraint is the salmon, which is nearly as long as he is tall: in every jaws-carry frame it is angled three-quarter with the nose swung toward the lens and the tail swung back past his shoulder, so it foreshortens to roughly his own shoulder width instead of doubling his silhouette and shrinking his head. A frame cannot be four-square and also hold a prop, so any frame needing hands is written as haunches or hind legs, and every jaws-carry frame keeps all four paws free to be down.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing four-square on flat palms and heels, blue bib apron hanging straight, stubby ringed tail low, chin lifted in calm quiet pride. The silver salmon is clamped crosswise in his jaws but angled three-quarter — nose swung toward the lens, tail back past his shoulder, coral stripe turned to camera — with one bead of water hanging off its tail fin, not yet fallen.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves

Half-lidded eyes aimed off past the camera at nothing, nobody left to holler at, rain beading on his ear tips — and no puddle, no wet floor, nothing painted under him.

eat.pose: Sitting up on his haunches with the salmon tucked along one forearm and pinned under the elbow, stripe out — he is absolutely not eating that — while the free paw tips a paper cup of clam chowder to his mouth and oyster crackers stick to the apron bib. The fish's blank glass eye happens to line up on the cup, deadpan, as though it would also like some.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Reared up on his hind legs in astonished delight, apron swinging, the salmon held up across both flat palms at chin height like a tray being presented, mouth open and eyes huge and shining — things are coming to him and he cannot believe it. umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Standing four-square and enormously smug with the salmon still crosswise in his jaws; the umbrella's crook is hooked over the apron's NECK strap behind his skull so the shaft rides up his back and the small canopy opens above and slightly behind his head, tilted back so it foreshortens no wider than his shoulders plus a palm each side. shield.pose: Crouched low on all fours and curled bodily around the fish, one shoulder into the blow, apron bunched tight, protecting the salmon instead of his own face with one eye screwed shut and teeth gritted around it. ko.pose: Flat on his back with the long skinny legs loose in the air, apron flopped askew across one shoulder, gold stars circling close above his head and his eyes gone to swooning sideways half-moons. dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his side with spiral eyes and tongue out, apron flopped over one ear, stars wheeling close above him. Dr. Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Quadrupedal at rest on flat plantigrade palms; he rears onto his haunches or up on his hind legs in any frame where a forepaw has to carry something.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all 18: navy mortarboard with a gold tassel off the viewer-left corner; navy gold-trimmed sash knotted at his right shoulder falling in a V across the chest; one firm cream diploma roll tied with a gold ribbon, carried held in a paw, bitten crossways in the jaws, clamped under an arm, or wedged through the sash — never set down, never out of frame. Three frame-specific held extras only: fry carton (eat), takeaway cup (coffee), black umbrella (umbrella).

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He is the hero's body exactly: round and spherical, no visible neck, head perched high above the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a SHORT STUBBY tail that never streams, ropes or curls out behind him. Raccoon hands are the whole point — flat plantigrade palms, five long spread fingers, heel down, never knuckles. The one real problem on this sheet is prop logistics: a frame cannot be four-square AND hold something, so whenever the diploma needs a hand he rears up, and whenever he must be four-square or running on all four limbs the diploma goes through the sash or into the jaws. The stubby tail cannot act as a tripod, so "reared up" here always means sitting back on the haunches or standing on both hind feet.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing four-square facing camera on flat spread palms, mortarboard dead level, chin a touch high, the rolled diploma wedged through the sash across his chest so no paw is borrowed. Gold tassel hangs still off the viewer-left corner, sash falls in a neat V, fine drizzle beading his shoulders.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: THE QUIET BEAT: sitting up on his haunches with the diploma open flat across his lap and both paws resting on it, but his half-lidded eyes are aimed past the camera at nothing — the ceremony is over and nobody stayed. Tassel has drooped forward past his cheek and he has not bothered to move it; one shoulder rain-dark.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sitting up on his haunches with a paper fry carton hugged to his chest in one paw, the other holding a single fry up between two fingers exactly like a piece of chalk mid-lecture, mouth open on a point nobody asked for. Diploma wedged through the sash with one stray fry balanced on its gold ribbon; tassel swinging in front of his eye and ignored.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Flattened low on all fours, haunches up, weight forward on spread plantigrade palms, mortarboard tipped down over his brow with the tassel dangling in front of his nose. Diploma bitten crossways low in the jaws, well below the eye line so his face still reads; eyes locked forward, dignity temporarily suspended.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Airborne on a compact upward diagonal — never stretched flat — front paws thrown forward with the diploma held ahead like a relay baton, hind legs tucked close, belly to the viewer, mouth open in a delighted bark. Sash and tassel kick back in short streaks that stay inside his own box; the mortarboard rides a hair clear of his head, still overlapping it.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Front paws slapped down flat with fingers spread, body low, weight absorbed through the shoulders, a tight ring of spray bursting off his own palms and hind feet and touching nothing else. Mortarboard slumped over one eye with the tassel across his face, diploma back through the sash, head coming up, whiskers forward.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on quadruped bound to the right, body low and long, all four limbs in the stride, diploma wedged tight through the sash so no paw is stolen from the run. Mortarboard jammed down over the brow, tassel and sash blown flat back along his spine, water flicking off his hind paws in a short contact spray.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat-out bound, limbs at full stretch, gold and cream speed streaks ripping past close along his flanks, eyes wide and ears pinned flat. The diploma has come untied in the sash and unrolled about a hand's length, the loose end curling back over his shoulder and no further — no paper tail leaves his box; tassel a rigid straight line behind him.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: FEET PLANTED, NOT RUNNING: up on his hind legs vibrating in place, takeaway cup raised in one paw, diploma clamped under the opposite arm, mortarboard knocked askew with the tassel caught mid-whip in a full blurred circle around his head doing all the motion work. Pupils tiny in enormous eyes, fur bristled, jitter lines, warm fire licks and pale cream steam curling up around his own back feet — one corner of the diploma very slightly singed.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Up on his hind legs, diploma half-unrolled between both paws at chest height, mortarboard level again, mouth open in pure astonished delight that the world is bringing him things. Gold bottlecaps and fries spiral in on a tight gold-and-cream arc that overlaps his silhouette, two already landed in the curl of the paper, tassel lifted on the swirl.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Up on his hind legs under a black umbrella whose canopy is only a little wider than his shoulders and tilted to keep clear of the frame edge, mortarboard perfectly dry and perfectly level beneath it, diploma pressed to his chest under the sash. Rain streaks off the rim into a short spray that touches his own feet — no puddle, no wet ring, no ground; small smug closed-mouth smile.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Braced low on his hind feet, both forearms up with the diploma held horizontally across his face like a professor blocking a thrown eraser, eyes squeezed shut, teeth gritted. A bright blue-violet energy dome flares tight around him with rain streaking off it; mortarboard knocked back on his crown, tassel flung upward.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Up on his hind legs, both paws clutching the rolled diploma to his chest like a very small shield, head craned back and up at the sky. Eyes huge and white-rimmed, ears flat, mortarboard slid back but still hooked on his skull with the tassel standing bolt upright, drizzle lines slanting past close.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Quadruped sprint to the left, mouth open in panic, short warm-red speed streaks hugging his flanks, ears flat, stubby tail bottled out. Mortarboard jammed low with the tassel whipping forward past his cheek, diploma still wedged in the sash with only its ribbon end flapping — nothing tears loose and no marks or symbols in the air.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Up on his hind legs, one arm bent up with the diploma raised, the other paw open just below the mortarboard he has flicked a thumb's width clear of his crown — the cap still overlaps his own head, tassel whirling. Gold ribbon sparks and confetti burst in close around his shoulders, mouth wide open, rain lit gold.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back, all four legs in the air with palms up, dazed half-moon lids and a small satisfied smile, gold stars circling his head — wounded dignity, entirely pleased with himself. Mortarboard tipped upside down against his shoulder and still touching him, tassel draped over his arm, and the diploma has unrolled across his belly to reveal a child's crayon drawing of a round raccoon beside a gold seal and ribbon — no lettering.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Slumped back on his haunches, spiral eyes, tongue out, stars looping close around his head. The mortarboard has rotated a quarter turn so the tassel hangs dead in front of his nose and he is going cross-eyed at it; the diploma sags in a floppy bent arc from one slack paw, still gripped.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst — soaked, arms flung up, mouth open in shock inside an exploding crown of bright white and cyan water that closes around his middle. Mortarboard gone to sodden cardboard folded over one ear, tassel plastered flat to his cheek, diploma limp and unfurling in one raised paw with the gold seal bleeding a soft halo — no ink lines, no letters.

labcoat.block:
Jimothy MD — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Plantigrade raccoon quadruped — flat palms, five long spread fingers, heels down — travelling on all fours in crouch, land, run-r, dash-run and flee, but reared up on planted hind feet whenever he is at rest, because the clipboard permanently occupies a forepaw and he is therefore NEVER standing four-square.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all 18 frames: rain-spotted warm off-white lab coat worn OPEN and unbuttoned (never fastened, never buttoned shut), narrow blue tie, stethoscope round the neck with both ends hanging down the chest, brow mirror centred on a headband, two pens in the coat's breast pocket, and the wooden clipboard with its metal clip and wordless chart pages carried in the LEFT forepaw — the pen comes out into the right paw in idle and sit only, and the pens leave the pocket in flee only.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
Identical body to the hero, so every pose ports one-for-one: round spherical torso, no visible neck, head perched high on the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a SHORT STUBBY ringed tail that stays close to the body and never streams, curls out behind or flicks water in any of the eighteen. The job costs him a limb, so the clipboard is a permanent extension of the left forepaw and is re-staged in every frame — lap desk when he sits, clamped under the elbow when both paws are needed, pressed flat beneath the palm on all-fours frames, riot shield when he is hit — which frees the right paw to do whatever plain Jimothy's right paw does. Because a paw is always occupied, he is never four-square: at rest he rears up on his haunches with both hind feet planted, and he gallops three-legged with the chart pinned to his ribs. The brow mirror, stethoscope and tie ride the head and neck and supply the trailing motion the hero gets from his whiskers and tail.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Reared up on his haunches with both hind feet planted and the round body square to camera, clipboard held flat against his chest in the left forepaw, capped pen loose in the right. Calm, unhurried, faintly bored bedside face, ears easy, stubby tail tucked close; the one hard white glint on his brow mirror is the brightest note in the frame.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sat back on his haunches, coat hanging open around his belly, clipboard flat across his knees as a lap desk with the pen working down a row of wordless ink squiggles. Head tipped, eyes half-lidded, ears relaxed — the exact posture of a man doing his paperwork on a bus bench because there is nowhere better to be.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sat on his haunches with the clipboard clamped under his left elbow against his ribs so both forepaws are free around a half-unwrapped deli sandwich, cut on the diagonal by somebody at home. Cheeks packed, eyes shut in bliss, brow mirror slid crooked down over one eye and no attempt made to fix it.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Flattened low on four flat palms with heels down and haunches loaded, the clipboard pressed flat beneath his left forepaw, coat rucked up over his shoulders. Stethoscope swung forward and hanging clear under his chin, whiskers back, eyes locked forward down the street, absolutely about to go.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne and stretched long, belly forward, hind legs trailing, clipboard thrust out ahead in the left paw like a doctor twelve minutes late to rounds. Coat tails and stethoscope stream back close behind him, tie flipped up over his shoulder, stubby tail tucked, and he looks openly delighted about it.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Front palms slapped down wide and body low, the clipboard taking part of the weight flat under the LEFT forepaw, coat billowing forward past his shoulders from the stop. Ears up, whiskers forward, a small spray of wet grit bursting off the palms and touching them.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on three-legged gallop to the right: the near left forepaw pins the clipboard to his ribs the way a chart gets carried down a corridor while the far forepaw and both hind feet do the work. Coat hem flaring back, stethoscope swung out on the curve, mouth shut, eyes on the far side of the street.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat-out horizontal sprint, legs stretched fore and aft, coat streaming straight back, brow mirror flashing, eyes wide with pinprick pupils. Orange fire licks at his paws and exactly ONE chart page tears back over his stubby tail, still caught in the clip and overlapping his body, with speed streaks no longer than half a body.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: Feet planted and body vibrating in place, standing bolt upright, fur bristled all over, a cafeteria paper cup in the right paw trailing pale blush-cream steam and the clipboard clamped under his left arm. That free left paw has the stethoscope bell pressed to his own chest and his eyebrows are climbing at what he can hear; pinprick pupils, short jitter lines tight to the body, small orange fire licks at his feet — all the energy, none of the travel.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Standing tall on his hind feet, mouth open in an astonished delighted grin, clipboard held up flat in both forepaws like a serving tray while bottlecaps, fries and wrapped snacks swirl in toward it. The swirl stays tight and overlapping his silhouette, his coat pockets are already overflowing, and one bottlecap has landed square in his brow mirror — pure joy that things are coming TO him.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Standing on his hind feet under a black umbrella hooked in the crook of his right elbow, canopy tipped toward camera and no wider than his open coat, the clipboard slid inside the coat against his chest and held there by his left forearm where the paperwork will stay dry. Rain breaking off the rim in short grey strokes that stop well inside the frame; utterly smug, utterly dry, one eyebrow up at the weather.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Dropped onto his haunches with the clipboard snapped up flat in front of his face like a tiny riot shield and the free right paw braced behind it, one eye squeezed shut, teeth gritted. A BRIGHT CYAN-WHITE energy dome flashes tight around him with rain streaking off its curve and two chart pages blown up off the board, still tethered at the clip.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Up on his hind feet, clipboard clutched flat to his chest in both paws like a shield he has not thought to raise, head tipped back to watch the sky. Eyes huge and white-rimmed, ears pinned flat, brow mirror tilted up and catching the light, stethoscope swinging loose off his neck.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Bolting three-quarter away toward the lower left, mouth open in flat panic, clipboard tucked under his left arm like a football, coat unbuttoned and flapping wide behind him. Red speed streaks off his heels and exactly two pens shaken out of the breast pocket, both close in and overlapping the flying coat so they cut as one shape.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Up on his hind feet, clipboard punched up in the left paw to just above the crown of his head and the right forepaw fisted at shoulder height, mouth wide open in a joyful whoop, eyes shut with the size of it. Brow mirror catching a star of light and one chart page fluttering up off the board, still clipped at its corner.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back with all four long limbs in the air, coat splayed open around him, stethoscope tangled comically across his snout, stubby tail pinned beneath him. The clipboard has landed face up on his belly and the trace on the chart dips flat then kicks straight back into a fat healthy bounce — one eye cracked open reading it with an eyebrow up, the other a dazed half-moon, gold stars circling his head.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled sitting up crooked with his tongue out and both eyes drawn as full spirals, the clipboard fallen flat across the top of his head at an angle like a slipped roof tile, its edge down over one spiralled eye. Headband shoved right round so the brow mirror sits behind one ear, chart pages fanned loose but still caught in the clip with one slid down over that ear, one forepaw half-raised in apology — spirals only here, no stars.

splash.pose: Soaked through and shocked rigid inside a bursting white and pale-cyan crown of water at his hips, both forepaws thrown up, coat plastered translucent to his fur and the brow mirror running with drips. The clipboard is still up in his left paw and its chart has gone to grey pulp, peeling off the board in one sad wet curl but never leaving it — he is far more offended about the paperwork than about the water.

skunk.block:
Skunk — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Quadrupedal plantigrade at rest — heel down, flat palms, all four feet on the ground — and he rears back onto a haunches-plus-tail tripod whenever a frame needs front paws; he never stands upright without that rear-up.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
None — no costume and no carried prop in any frame; the tail is his only permanent equipment. The four frame-local props are: takeaway box + grub (eat only), gold bottlecaps and fries (magnet only), paper coffee cup (coffee only), folded thrift-store umbrella (umbrella only) — they appear nowhere else.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He is a short-legged plantigrade quadruped with no true hands, so every pose that needs arms is solved the way a real striped skunk solves it: he rears back on his haunches into a tripod of two hind feet plus the tail and works with two dextrous front paws. The great plume is the third limb and does the jobs Jimothy's arms do — parasol, windbreak, cushion, banner, backstop — but it is NOT prehensile: it fans, arches over the back, bottle-brushes and drapes, and it never grips, wraps, carries or scoops anything. He is famously near-sighted, so the squint is always aimed slightly wide of whatever he is actually looking at. Standing rule: four-square only when both front paws are empty and on the ground (idle only); any frame with a prop or a raised paw must be sat back on the haunches or reared on the hind legs.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing four-square at three-quarter camera, glossy black guard hairs beaded with rain, the double white stripe running clean from forehead over the back, the great plume carried high like a parade banner and curling forward past his ears. Small amber eyes in a polite near-sighted squint, a faint contented smile, and nothing at all under his paws — no puddle, no reflection, no shadow; this is the existing idle.png and his head size here is the measuring stick for the other seventeen.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sat back on his haunches, back rounded, front paws tucked into the white chest fur, eyes half-lidded and aimed slightly wide of whatever he is watching — the near-sighted stare at a blur of lights he cannot quite resolve. The plume has swept down and forward to lie against his forefeet like a dropped stole, so he is sitting warm inside his own tail while the rain keeps coming down; this is the sheet's quiet, slightly lonely beat.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sat up on his haunches with a rain-softened takeaway box tipped open between his hind feet, fries ignored, one fat pale garden grub held in both front paws like corn on the cob, eyes shut in genuine bliss. The plume arches over his back and curves down behind the box as a windbreak so the rain cannot get in — considerate, slightly gross, entirely him.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Flattened low on all fours, haunches up, chest almost to the ground but with nothing painted beneath it, whiskers forward, eyes locked up-screen. The tail is pressed low and long behind him like a loaded spring with the plume tip waved up to stay inside the box, and his forepaws blur mid-drum in the little warning stamp a skunk does before anything happens (existing crouch.png).

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne and stretched, all four short legs spread wide, belly forward, mouth open in delight, near-sighted eyes as wide as they go. The plume streams back and then CURVES UP behind him into a tall banner arc — tip painted, never cropped, never stretched flat across the cell — so the frame stays the same 207x250 portrait as idle and he does not shrink for the middle of every single hop.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Front paws planted with a tight splash ring bursting off the pads and up his forelegs — contact spray only, no puddle and no ring on the floor — chest low, haunches still dropping, weight visibly absorbed. The tail has whipped forward over his own back and overshot past his nose, plume fanned across his face, so he is momentarily half-buried in his own tail and squinting out through it.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on to the right, body low and stretched long, short legs at full extension, the plume held back and waved up in a lazy S so it climbs inside the box rather than lengthening the cell. In profile the forehead stripe and one amber eye carry the identity, and his face wears a small determined scowl, because he is not fast and he knows it.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat out and side-on, legs at full stretch and barely touching down, ears pinned, eyes huge, tongue out the side of his mouth, the plume swept back and curved up into a white torpedo with short speed lines that stop well inside the margin and two loose plume hairs tumbling in the streak. A soft pastel mint-and-cream clover puff blooms at the tail's base like a little booster — sparkly, aimed back at empty road, never yellow-green or brown, never a cloud or a jet, and nothing in frame reacts to it.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: Reared up on his hind legs and DEAD STILL, both feet planted flat, a paper cup clamped in both front paws, coffee slopping over the rim onto his own wrist, steam curling off in pale blush-cream (never hot pink). Every hair of the plume has stood on end and bottle-brushed to twice its width with jitter lines ticking off it, pupils shrunk to two dots, two small warm-orange fire licks curling off his hind feet — all the energy is vibration and bristled fur, no speed lines, no travel.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Sat up on his haunches with both front paws cupped open at his chest, mouth open in pure astonishment and delight — things are coming TO him and he cannot believe his luck. The plume is fanned wide and vertical behind him as a catcher's screen: gold bottlecaps and fries fly in from just inside the frame, stick in the fur, bounce off it and cascade down the plume into his paws — the tail is a backstop, never a basket, and nothing collects on a floor because there is no floor.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Sat up on his haunches with the whole plume arced forward over his head as a fat white parasol, rain sheeting off it in bright ribbons and not one drop reaching him. A cheap folded thrift-store umbrella is tucked unopened under one front paw, purely for show, and his squint is enormously smug about owning two roofs.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: The instant of the hit: flinched down flat, ears back, eyes squeezed shut, one front paw thrown up over his face. A blue-violet energy dome snaps tight around him — never blue-violet or purple, which the cutter eats — dented outward at the crown where the bolt-upright plume shoves against it, rain streaking hard down the outside.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: The real skunk warning display: front half dropped low, back arched high, all four feet down, both forepaws blurred mid-stamp in a panicked drum roll, plume snapped bolt upright and fanned into a full flag. His head twists up and back but the near-sighted squint is aimed at the wrong patch of grey sky, one ear cocked, a single fat painted exclamation mark tucked against the plume so it overlaps his silhouette, and the faintest pastel mint sparkle at the tail base.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting left, low and scrambling, mouth open in panic, wet fur plastered over eyes gone huge, a tight burst of water flicking off the pads themselves (on the paws, never on a floor) and short warm orange-red speed streaks stopping inside the margin. The plume drags in a wobbling panicked wave instead of a proud banner, because for the first time in his life the thing behind him is not getting out of his way.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Reared up on his hind legs, compact rather than stretched, both front paws flung up beside his head, eyes squeezed shut in a huge grin, chest stripe blazing. The plume fans straight up into a white firework and the whole celebration stays INSIDE that fan — pastel mint and cream clover puffs and sparkles held within the plume, none of it near the frame edge — so the cell keeps the 207x250 box and his head stays exactly idle-sized.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back with all four short legs sticking straight up, tongue lolling to one side, one ear folded over, eyes closed into swooning half-moon lids (never X's) and three little stars circling his head. The great plume has spread flat beneath him like a fur fainting couch so he has landed in completely unearned luxury, rain falling gently on his upturned white belly — suspiciously comfortable, funny-sad, never grim.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled belly-down and splayed out like a dropped rug, spiral eyes, tongue out, stars wobbling around his head. The plume is bent up above him into a lazy question mark and his back is dusted with swept-up leaves and wet grit that all sit ON the fur — nothing scattered on the ground, and no loose hairs drifting free in this frame.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst: front half heaved up inside an exploding crown of water, both forepaws thrown skyward, mouth open in shock, eyes enormous, soaked through and plainly out of play. Behind him the glorious plume has collapsed into a sad wet rope a third of its size with a few bubbles off the tip — the ruined tail is the joke and the small heartbreak — and there is no separate water plane or surface line painted below him.
