slug.block:
Banana Slug — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Prone gastropod — never bipedal, never four-square, no limbs at any point: one muscular foot on the deck with the front third reared up, and his body length always spent in a curve or an S so the head rides high and the painted box stays near-square.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
No costume and nothing held in any frame — the constants in all 18 are his own body: banana-yellow gloss, the identical black leopard-spot map, the darker olive mantle saddle over the front third, the pneumostome painted as a same-tone dimple on the right flank, one long specular highlight down the back, two eyestalks plus two lip-feelers, and a SHORT glossy slime stub touching his tail at the same length every single frame.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
The two eyestalks do every job an arm would do — pointing, splaying, flinching, cheering — but they are hydrostatic, fluid pressure with no skeleton, so they invert into the head at the lightest touch: they can never bear weight, never prop anything up and never hold. Props therefore only ever stick to his slime, lie against his flank, or drape over his back; nothing is gripped. The travelling muscle wave banding down his foot does every job a leg would do, so speed is sold by how tight and fast that banding reads, never by how long a trail is. He rears by lifting the front third off the deck, which means he is never four-square and never has a spare limb — there was never a limb to spare.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Front third reared up off the deck with the rest of him curled into a shallow S beneath, both eyestalks tall and splayed, the two lip-feelers tasting the rain, mouth a calm soft line. Wet gloss down the back, the short slime stub curled at his tail, and nothing else in the cell.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Off duty: body settled into a fat comma, mantle relaxed, both eyestalks drooped to half mast and lazily crossed at the tips, eyes half-lidded in the rain and mouth a small content line. A thin glossy collar of slime is pressed out tight around his own outline, no wider than a lip-feeler — the last one still out here, and perfectly happy about it.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Nose-deep in a fallen chanterelle stuck to his own chest by the slime, rasping a neat scalloped bite out of the cap, one eyestalk tipped down to watch the food while the other stays up on lookout. A soggy Pike Place fry is glued flat against his flank with one identical scallop already taken out of it, abandoned as too dry.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Gathered to spring: concertina'd to half his length and twice his height, ridged like a squeezed accordion, mantle flared, both eyestalks pulled halfway back into his head and aimed up-screen. The slime stub is bunched into a tight glossy pleat at his tail, loaded like a spring.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne on a steep diagonal, arced belly-forward like a thrown banana with his nose up-screen and tail low so he fills the cell corner to corner, both eyestalks streaming back like ribbons, mouth open in undignified delight. The stub has snapped clean at his tail into a short curl and three flung dew droplets, all of it tucked in against his own outline.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: A belly-flop: the front third splatted wide and flat with a tight ring of slime squirting out right at the contact edge, the back half still arriving in a visible ripple down his foot. Both eyestalks have whipped forward past his own face from the impact, eyes crossed for a beat, grinning anyway.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on and travelling right in a low shallow S, the muscular wave banding down his foot like rolling light, eyestalks laid back streamlined, jaw set with total determination. The stub stays short at his tail and the motion arcs hugging his flank are honestly, comically tiny — this is his top speed.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: The same side-on sprint flat out: body drawn thin, the foot waves compressed into a blur of banding, eyestalks pinned straight back, eyes wide, mouth open. Warm amber friction licks and one pale cream steam curl come off the foot's contact edge while the tail stub throws a tight spray of droplets — every effect touching him.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: Dead still and visibly vibrating: reared up on his back third with the foot planted, double-image blur on both eyestalks, pupils shrunk to pin dots, the whole front of him glossed espresso-dark because he crawled straight through the spill rather than carrying it. The tipped takeaway cup lies against his own flank giving off pale blush-cream steam, with short jitter lines at his mantle and warm amber fire licks flickering at the stub.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Reared up with his mouth open in a delighted round O and both eyestalks splayed wide in pure astonishment, because with him everything sticks: gold bottlecaps already glued along his back like sequins and one fry stuck flat to an eyestalk. Three more caps spiral in on short curved arcs that overlap his body, close enough to be about to land on him.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: He crawled UNDER it — a fallen big-leaf maple drapes over his back and mantle with its stem still hooked at the tip of his tail so it reads as deliberately dragged into place, the front edge lifted just enough that his head and both fully extended stalks poke out clean. Rain sheets off the leaf's drip tip in one bright stream, and one fat drop has got through onto his back, which he is plainly thrilled about: eyes half-lidded and smug.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: The hit lands: both eyestalks snap fully inside his head leaving two dimples, the body clenched into a tight tense hump, mantle flared, mouth a shocked little slot. A bright blue-violet dome flares tight around him with rain streaking off it, and the maple leaf is still stemmed to his tail but flipped back over itself and crumpled.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Coiled back tight with his front end craned up-screen, both eyestalks stretched to full periscope height and bent to point dead at the sky, pupils huge, one bead of slime-sweat wobbling on his mantle. The diving gull's shadow falls as a hard dark bar across his own back and mantle only.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Absolute maximum slug velocity, which is nothing: body stretched to its longest inside the same box, foot waves frantic, eyestalks streaming back with a bold red double exclamation mark sitting right on top of them, mouth open in panic, a fine mist of slime flung off his flank. The red speed streaks are so short they are the joke.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Reared as tall as he goes on the last third of his foot with the rest of him looped beneath for width, both eyestalks flung skyward in a wide V with the little feelers up too, mouth open in a whoop, back arched proud in warm gold light. The stub at his tail curls up into one short glittering silver loop — a victory streamer the size of a shoelace.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Rolled foot-up and still gently rocking, pale glossy belly-foot to the sky with only the curve of his back touching down; all four tentacles flop backward and DOWN over his own upturned face, the two long ones drooping past his eyes like wet noodles and the lip-feelers splayed sideways. Eyes are two dazed little dots pointing in slightly different directions, mouth slack, three stars circling close above him, and one bright slime smear still glossing the flank he skidded on.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled in a loose S with both eyestalks crossed and tied in a soft overhand knot, a spiral in each eye, mouth slack in a woozy smile, his back striped with brush-bristle dust and street grit. The tail stub is corkscrewed into one tight turn and three stars circle close above his head.

splash.pose: Caught inside the burst, not under it: soaked and water-darkened with a crown of pale cyan-white exploding around his middle, both eyestalks flung up and out in shock and his mouth a round startled O. His slime stub is dissolving into pale milky curls at his tail — the actually sad part, and he knows it.

otter.block:
River Otter — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Quadruped at rest — long low spine, short bandy plantigrade legs with flat palms and heels down — who rears onto his haunches with the thick rudder tail braced behind as a third leg whenever he needs his forepaws.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
No clothing and no costume: one prop only, a smooth green river stone, present in all 18 frames — held in a forepaw or clamped chin-to-chest when he is still, carried in his jaws when he is travelling, and loose at his own hip in flee alone.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He has a raccoon's dexterous forepaws and none of a raccoon's legs: long low spine, short plantigrade limbs, and a tail thick enough to work as a third leg, so every raccoon standing pose becomes a rear-up onto the haunches with the tail braced behind, and every raccoon run becomes the true humpback otter bound or a belly slide. He is four-square in idle only, and a four-square frame cannot also hold something in a forepaw — that is exactly why the stone rides in his jaws there. There is no armpit pouch and no chest-anvil floating on his back: that is a sea otter, and nothing he carries may depend on either. He is never dry in any frame — wet fur peaked into dark spikes along the spine, all eighteen.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing four-square, all four palms and heels flat down, long body in a lazy S with the thick tail laid in a shallow arc to his right and the green stone carried gently in his jaws. Head up, whiskers dripping, eyes soft and a little far away — an otter who has been waiting on this corner a while.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sat bolt upright on his haunches, tail flat behind him doing the work of a third leg, both forepaws folded on his pale belly cradling the green stone. Shoulders dropped, eyes half-lidded, rain running off his chin in a steady thread — no puddle and no floor, he is simply soaked and in no hurry to be anywhere.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Hunched belly-down and angled three-quarter to camera, elbows out, hind feet splayed behind, tail flat; the green stone is pinned under his left forepaw as an anvil while the right brings a mussel down onto it, head cocked to watch the crack. A tipped paper tray of fried clams and two shell halves lean against his elbow and shoulder in physical contact — nothing loose, no puddle, no pavement painted.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Coiled low with the spine compressed into a tight hump, elbows tucked under the chest, hind feet planted wide, chin almost down and eyes locked up-screen. The stone is clamped in his teeth ready for the jump, tail laid straight behind him, nothing painted beneath him.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Airborne on a rising diagonal toward the camera, body curved like a banana rather than stretched flat, forepaws reaching forward, hind feet trailing and the tail curled up behind to keep the box square. Mouth open in a delighted hoot, the stone clamped in the crook of his left elbow against his chest, a tight shake of water beads coming off his fur no further out than a paw's width.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Front paws slapping down flat, spine humping up behind them, hind feet skidding in underneath, whiskers thrown forward and the head coming back up. A low crown of rain bursts right at his palms where they make contact and the tail whips upward for balance; stone still in the crook of his left elbow, no ground and no cast shadow under him.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on humpback bound to the right in the true otter rhythm, back arched high at the middle, fore and hind paws gathering underneath him, ears pinned flat, tail arced up and behind rather than streaming out flat. The stone rides in his jaws on the centre line — deliberately, so this frame mirrors clean — with spray flicking off the paws themselves and no puddles painted behind.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Belly slide angled three-quarter toward the camera with the spine curved rather than dead straight, forelegs tucked back along his flanks, hind feet still shoving, chin an inch off nothing, stone switched into his teeth. Cheeks pushed back, eyes wide with glee; wake is two short curls at the shoulders and the speed streaks run no longer than half his body — box capped at 1.35:1, run-r's silhouette is the target.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: Standing dead still and vibrating: reared on both hind feet with the tail braced behind as a tripod, a takeaway cup already half crushed in both forepaws, the green stone clamped under his chin against his chest. Pinprick pupils, whiskers straight out, every wet spike bristled, pale blush-cream steam off the lid, short jitter lines hugging his outline and small warm heat licks touching his own feet — no fire on the ground, no forward lean, no travel in this pose at all.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Up on his haunches with the tail as tripod, head back and mouth open in pure astonishment, both forepaws juggling three gold bottlecaps in a low arc that rises no higher than his own crown — delight at being given things, never appetite. More caps and a few fried clams spiral in and touch his chest and shoulders, everything inside half a body width; the stone stays clamped under his chin and the tail thumps hard enough to fling water off its own tip.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Sat upright on his haunches, one forepaw on the shaft of a small plain umbrella held at a lazy tilt low over his left shoulder, the other cradling the green stone in his lap. Half his face still gets rained on and he could not care less — eyes lidded, deeply smug; one short bright curtain of rain sheets off the canopy rim and stops well inside the frame, and there is no lettering or logo anywhere on the canopy.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Dropped low and braced, both flat forepaws up in front of his muzzle, whiskers flattened back, eyes screwed shut, tail clamped tight along his own flank. A bright blue-violet dome flashes close around him with rain and grit streaking off its skin, and the stone is jammed between his chin and chest where he clamped down on it.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Reared into the bolt-upright periscope stand otters really do, hind feet together and the tail curved out behind as both tripod and wide base, neck stretched as tall as it goes. Both forepaws clutched to his chest around the green stone, eyes huge and rolled upward, mouth a small round O, every wet hair on his back standing in spikes.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Panic belly-slide to the left, angled three-quarter to camera with the spine curved, forepaws thrown out ahead, mouth wide open, tail thrashing behind. The green stone has bounced out of his teeth and tumbles just off his hip, overlapping his own tail — clearly dropped but still on him; short white shock spikes and flung water beads only, no punctuation marks, no fanned water on a floor that does not exist.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Reared to full height on both hind feet with the tail arced out behind as a broad tripod, one forepaw punched up holding the green stone overhead like a trophy, elbow bent so the stone clears his crown by no more than a head. Head thrown back, mouth open in a whooping chirp, a short bright arc of water flung off the tail tip, belly fur gloriously soaked.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back but rolled three-quarter toward the camera so the box stays near square, all four short legs in the air, thick tail flopped out flat to one side. Swooning half-moon lids, tongue out the corner, gold stars circling his head, and the stone has landed on his belly and simply stayed there — he looks suspiciously comfortable, as though this was always the plan.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his side in a loose comma angled toward the camera, tail curled up over his own nose, spiral eyes, tongue lolling, ears at half mast. One forepaw pats vaguely around for the green stone, which is resting against his own pads the entire time — spirals only here, no orbiting stars, so he stays visually distinct from ko.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst: caught inside a wide low white water crown that rises no more than a head above him, soaked flat, forepaws thrown up with the stone still clamped in the right one. Ears pinned, whiskers plastered, eyes wide and jaw open in an outraged squeak — the one animal on the roster built for this and he is deeply offended by it; nobody sinks, nobody swims, the burst is the whole read.

heron.block:
Great Blue Heron — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Upright biped — he stands over two long stilt legs with the body carried vertically and the neck folded into an S; never on all fours, never "four-square", and a wing is never used as a hand.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
No costume and no permanent prop — the heron is bare; props appear in exactly four frames and always touch the body: plain paper chip cone in the bill (eat), plain takeaway cup skewered on the bill (coffee), incoming chips/battered scraps/bottlecaps on tight arcs (magnet), plain umbrella hooked over the gape (umbrella).

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He has no hands, so the bill and the gape do every carry: the dagger skewers or grips, and food goes down the throat whole in one visible travelling lump. The wings only go up, out and forward-mantled over the crown — they never cross the chest, never point, never hold, and never take weight. Where Jimothy panics with his whole body, the heron panics from the ankles up: feet planted, face unchanged, stillness as the gag. Because his neck folds and extends, his total height is the one thing that can wreck the sheet — every frame is capped at about 1.15x the idle height so his head stays the same pixel size in all eighteen.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing square on both stilt legs, dead still, neck folded into a shallow S so the head rides low over the shoulders and the yellow dagger bill points level at the camera. Shaggy slate chest plumes hang without stirring, the single black crest feather trails off the back of the skull, the gold eye is fixed on the viewer and very slightly narrowed — nothing on him moves, and that is the pose.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: The quiet frame: one leg vanished entirely up into the belly feathers, the whole bird settled into a soft grey bell on a single stilt, neck folded flat so the bill lies along the chest, eyes half-lidded. Rain beads on his back and the plumes puff over the tucked foot — a wet lawn ornament nobody is coming to look at. No loose feathers, nothing painted beneath him.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Bill tipped straight up with a plain paper cone of chips gripped in the bill tip and tipping its last inch down the throat, a fat comedy lump already halfway down the long neck and visibly stretching the feathers. Both feet planted, cone touching the bill and nothing spilled or scattered anywhere, one gold eye rolled down to hold eye contact with the camera the entire time he swallows.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Coiled to strike: hocks folded back deep, body dropped low over the toes, neck compressed into a tight spring-loaded Z with the bill aimed forward like a nocked arrow. Wings shut tight to the body, crest feather flattened back, gold eye wide and locked on the row ahead — all the energy stored, none of it leaked out yet.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Airborne with the wings only HALF-spread, wrists high and cupped and the primaries closed rather than fanned, and the long legs folded up tight under the belly instead of trailing. Neck tucked into the shoulders, bill forward, two or three flecks of loose down close in under his chest — this is a hop that never quite becomes flight, and the frame is no wider than idle.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Wings cupped forward to brake but still only half open, toes splayed enormous and reaching down, knees folding to absorb it, neck flung out forward for balance with the bill level. One tight white splash-ring bursting at the touching foot and physically touching it — no puddle, no pavement, no cast shadow.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on to the right at a long heron stride, one leg fully extended forward and the other trailing straight back, wings cracked barely open as outriggers held close to the body, neck folded neatly into place. He is moving fast and looks like he is merely walking somewhere on purpose; a slight forward tilt is the only concession to speed. He carries nothing and has no asymmetric marking, so this frame mirrors cleanly.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat out: legs at full scissor stretch, body low and level, wings held half-open and steady, short white speed streaks touching his shins and a tight spray flicking off the back toe and staying attached to it. The neck stays folded and the face stays utterly composed — the legs are a blur, the head glides along a perfectly straight line.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: Standing absolutely still and badly wired: the dagger bill run clean through the sip hole of a plain unmarked takeaway lid so the cup hangs skewered at eye level, pale blush-cream steam curling past the gold iris, coffee already running back down the bill. Feet planted and going nowhere, crest bolt upright, chest plumes fanned electric, pupil shrunk to a pinprick in a huge gold iris, one stilt leg blurred with vibration.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Feet rooted, bill cranked wide open at the sky like a delivery chute, gold eye huge and bright with pure astonishment as chips, battered scraps from a paper tray and gold bottlecaps spiral in on short tight arcs that all overlap his body, one chip already dropping down the gullet. Wings barely lifted — he has not taken a single step toward any of it, and he is quietly thrilled that he did not have to.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: The umbrella's crook hooked over the base of his upper mandible right at the gape, shaft running up and back so the open canopy rides above and slightly behind his skull like a parasol on a stick. Bill level, gold eye clear and thoroughly smug under the rim, one leg tucked away, rain streaking off the canopy edge only — no dry circle, no pavement, no print on the fabric.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: The instant of the hit: both wings mantled up and forward over the crown, wrists nearly meeting above the skull with the primaries curtaining down past his cheeks, and a bright blue-violet energy dome flaring tight around him with rain sparking off it. One gold eye peers out under the wrist, and his feet have not moved a millimetre from where they were.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Reed alarm, capped: neck stretched and slimmed to a stick but only about 1.15x the idle height, bill raised to roughly 60 degrees rather than vertical, every feather clamped flat to the body. Eyes rolled to the top of their sockets doing all the work, crest feather quivering, two thin nervous motion-ticks tight either side of the head — the most dignified terror in Seattle.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting at a full comic stride, wings half-open for balance, short red speed streaks touching both heels, two small exclamation ticks close over his head and a couple of body feathers shaken loose beside his flank. The neck is still folded and the bill still level — he is running for his life with his head travelling along a perfectly flat line, which somehow makes it worse.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: The courtship display let loose but capped like leap: wings thrown up and out only HALF-spread, lacy chest plumes fanned into a shawl, head arched back and bill wide open in a great creaky rusty-gate honk, both feet finally off the ground by an inch. Rain-glitter close around him and no loose feathers; the whole frame stays inside the idle box — a lifetime of composure spent all at once.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: He does not go feet-up, he FOLDS: collapsed straight down onto his keel like a deckchair, legs concertina'd underneath him, wings slack out to either side, neck poured down into a loose loop. Bill primly shut, eyes swooned to half-moon lids (no X's), three stars circling the skull — mortified, and quietly determined that nobody saw.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his side, neck gone completely loose in a dropped-garden-hose S, one wing trapped under him and the other folded up over the crown and drooping across one eye. Spiral eyes, bill hanging ajar, crest feather bent in three directions, both stilt legs crossed at the ankles in the air — nothing painted underneath him.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst: chest-deep in an exploding white and pale-cyan crown of water, one wing thrown up and the other half-spread slapping the surface, plumes plastered flat so the mighty neck reads as a soaked pipe cleaner. Bill wide open in an outraged squawk, gold eye enormous — a water bird betrayed by water and taking it extremely personally. He stays inside the crown; he is not going anywhere and he is certainly not going under.

coyote.block:
Discovery Park Coyote — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a hand-painted hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
QUADRUPED, locked: a digitigrade canid who stands and moves on four toes-down feet in all eighteen frames — he never rises onto two legs, never has a free "hand", and the only frames where he is off his feet are leap, ko, dizzy and splash.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
NONE — no clothes, no permanent prop, jaws empty and nothing underfoot in fifteen of eighteen frames; the only props on the whole sheet are the torn takeout bag + one long fry (eat), the sleeved paper cup (coffee), the incoming bottlecaps and fries (magnet), and ONE umbrella that appears in exactly two frames (umbrella, shield) and never once leaves his teeth.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He has no hands, so every raccoon pose that holds something becomes jaws-and-forepaw: the cup and the umbrella are carried in the teeth, the takeout bag is pinned flat under one splayed forepaw, and every "raise your arms" beat becomes something a canid actually does — cheer is a full howl, scared is hackles up with one forepaw lifted, ko is belly-up with all four legs folded in the air. He is DIGITIGRADE, the exact opposite of Jimothy: toes down, heel and hock never touching, no flat palms, no grip, no thumb. Standing rules a painter must not break — all four feet stay under him at rest, a prop in any standing frame lives in the JAWS and never becomes a fifth limb, and the black-tipped brush tail must physically touch the body silhouette in every single frame or the connected-component cut orphans it and ships a coyote with no tail.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Standing four-square in three-quarter view, weight settled on straight forelegs, tall ears pricked with one rotated slightly off-axis as if already tracking the next lane, gold eyes level with the camera. Brush tail hangs low with its black tip well clear of the bottom of the frame, mouth closed in that faint unbothered line, jaws empty and nothing underfoot — no pavement, no shadow, no puddle.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sat back on his haunches, forelegs straight and tidy, chest high, brush tail curled around his front feet with the black tip laid over one paw. Head turned three-quarters away with ears half-back and one gold eye catching low dawn light, the gaze aimed off at something the sheet never paints — the patrol briefly off duty, and this is the one quiet, lonely frame on the sheet.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Hunkered over a torn paper takeout bag pinned flat under one splayed forepaw, head swung back around to camera mid-chew with a single long fry held crosswise in his teeth the way a dog carries a stick it will not give back, one end drooping. Ears up, eyes half-lidded and entirely unrepentant; every remaining fry stays inside the mouth of the bag under his paw, nothing scattered loose outside his outline.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Coiled to launch: chest dropped low, elbows out, hindquarters bunched high over gathered back feet, tail carried low with the black tip curving up to touch his own rump. Ears flat forward, gold eyes locked up-screen, a few grains of grit ticking off the back paw and still touching it — nothing painted beneath him.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: A GATHERED bound, not a stretched one: spine folded, forelegs reaching with the elbows kept in, hind legs tucked up under the belly, brush tail curved up and touching his back so the whole shape stays compact and roughly square. Ears back, mouth just open in the private delight of a working animal who is very good at exactly one thing and knows nobody is watching — he is commuting, not hunting.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Forepaws slapped down and splayed wide, shoulders sunk between them absorbing the drop, hindquarters still coming down behind and the tail flicked up against his flank for balance. Ears snapped forward, a tight burst of rain-spray and grit bursting AT the pads and touching them, spreading no wider than his own chest.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on facing RIGHT in a compact diagonal trot, near foreleg and far hind leg swinging together with the stride kept short of full reach, head carried dead level, tail low and steady. Chin up, unhurried — the posture of a coyote who is not crossing the street so much as permitting it — with a thin veil of pale dawn mist lying right along his back.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Same side-on RIGHT and flat out, but painted at the GATHERED moment of the gallop: all four feet off the ground with the spine folded and the legs collected under him, tail curved up against the rump. Ears pinned, eyes wide, tongue just out, three or four short warm-white speed ticks starting at his heels and touching them — no long trail, no grit under the belly.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: He is NOT running — all four feet planted and dead still, the whole body vibrating in place, because the engine holds this frame for up to seven seconds while the player stands there. A paper cup clamped by its cardboard sleeve in his teeth with the lid dented by tooth marks and PALE CREAM steam curling off it, pupils shrunk to pinpricks in the gold eyes, hackles standing in a dark ridge, tail up but angled back, jitter lines hugging his outline and small orange heat licks touching all four paws.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Up on his toes with weight rocked back and ears up, gold eyes wide with plain astonished joy as a gold bottlecap arrives right at the tip of his nose entirely by itself — he is not snatching, it is coming to him, and he cannot believe his luck. More bottlecaps and fries curve in on a tight spiral that stays within half a body width and overlaps his outline everywhere, tail sweeping a happy blur.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Standing four-square and bone dry, biting the umbrella SHAFT high — an inch or two under the canopy — so the open umbrella sits on top of his skull like a hat and the curved crook dangles down past his brisket. Head tilted slightly to balance it, ears dry under the rim, eyes half-lidded and insufferably pleased, short rain ticks streaking off both sides of the canopy; no puddle, no wet ground, nothing beneath his paws.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Braced and dropped low with forelegs splayed, head twisted away, eyes squeezed shut and ears pinned flat — and the umbrella STILL in his teeth, blown completely inside out over his skull, which is the joke. A blue-violet dome flares tight around him with rain and grit streaking off its skin: never violet, never dark, and never further off his fur than a hand's width.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Rocked back on his haunches in three-quarter view, chest lifted, one forepaw held up and out to the SIDE and the head craned up and back on an angle rather than stacked straight up, so the frame stays no taller than idle. Ears flat to his skull, hackles spiked into a dark ridge along the spine, tail tucked hard forward between the hind legs, gold eyes enormous and rimmed with white.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Full gallop to the LEFT, belly low, legs at reach but the hind pair folding under him and the brush tail curved and touching the rump so the shape never stretches into a horizontal streak. Ears pinned, mouth open in a thoroughly undignified yelp, three short warm-white ticks off his heels — all that athleticism, none of the composure — and nothing floating above his shoulders.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Front paws planted wide in three-quarter view, chest thrown out, head tipped all the way back with the muzzle pointed up in a full howl, eyes shut, ears laid back, tail high and waving. Three short song-lines curl out of his open mouth and stay touching the muzzle — no arm to raise, so he raises his voice.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back with all four legs folded loosely in the air, tongue out one side, dazed swooning half-moon lids (never X eyes, never spirals — spirals belong to dizzy), one ear folded inside out against his own skull and the brush tail flopped along his flank inside the silhouette. A tight ring of small gold stars orbits close enough to overlap his head; the read is mortified professional dignity — the animal who never misses, caught belly-up.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his side with his legs still walking on nothing, spiral eyes and tongue lolling, his whole coat combed into ridiculous swirls and cowlicks by the sweeper brushes. Top ear flops back while the under ear squashes flat, tail lies in line with the body, and two wet leaves stay stuck flat IN the combed fur — no circling stars here, and no pile of sweepings on any ground.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst: head and shoulders exploding up inside a tight white and pale-cyan crown of water, forelegs flung high, ears pinned, gold eyes huge and mouth open in pure offended shock — soaked, out of play, and deeply insulted about it. Fur plastered so his legs and ruff read half their usual fluffy width while the HEAD stays exactly the same size as every other frame, brush tail hanging as a sad wet rope still touching his body.

seal.block:
Harbor Seal — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Pinniped, not quadruped and not biped: belly-down on his ribs in every frame, chest lifted only by the arch of his own spine, back half a heavy sausage that never leaves the ground except in leap, ko, dizzy and splash.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
None — he wears nothing in any frame; the only constants are bare silver-grey spotted hide, cream belly and a rain sheen along the spine. Every prop is single-frame and named in that frame: chip basket (eat), takeaway cup on the nose (coffee), flying chips and gold bottlecaps (magnet), black umbrella bitten by the shaft (umbrella, and the same umbrella blown inside out in shield). Nothing else appears anywhere.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He has no hands and no hind legs, so every raccoon solve is done with the belly: he balances things on his nose instead of holding them, pins things under a flat flipper instead of gripping, and rears only from the ribs up. LOCKED FLIPPER LAW — the fore-flippers reach OUT and DOWN only: they steady him at his flanks but never bear his weight (the chest comes up off the spinal arch, never off a propping flipper), never rise above the shoulder line, and never touch the face. When he is inverted in ko and splash, "out and down along the body" points at the sky, and that is the only way a flipper is ever up. He can never stand four-square and can never hold a prop in a limb.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Three-quarter to camera with the rear half foreshortened away so his box stays near square: chest lifted on the arch of his spine, fore-flippers lying flat at his flanks, head high and tipped a fraction back, big black wet eyes on the lens, whiskers relaxed. Rain sheen down the spine and the belly visibly flattened where it meets the ground — nothing painted underneath him, no smear, no puddle, no shadow.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Fully off duty in the harbour-seal banana, head and rear flippers lifted together so he rocks on his ribs, one fore-flipper laid low across his belly, eyes half shut and mouth curved in a small closed smile. This is the quiet one: he is looking past the camera up the canal at a boat that already went by, and the waiting is as real as the contentment.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Head thrown back mid-gulp with a battered cod half swallowed and its tail still out of his mouth, a red-and-white paper basket pinned flat under one fore-flipper against his chest — matchbox-sized against a seal — and one chip stuck to a whisker. A hard-edged gull-wing shadow falls across his own back and across the paper (no gull, and no shadow on the ground); he is side-eyeing it without stopping.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Poured flat and loaded forward: spine compressed into a low hump behind the shoulders, chin almost on the deck, fore-flippers flat and turned in at his sides steadying rather than pushing, rear half foreshortened toward camera, eyes locked up-screen. A tight fan of spray flicking off the outer edge of each fore-flipper where he has already begun to shove — touching him, nothing on the road.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Airborne and briefly beautiful: body arched into a shallow banana at three-quarter, fore-flippers swept tight to his sides, rear flippers trailing and fanned open, belly forward, mouth slightly open in delight. A compact burst of water breaking off his own belly and rear flippers with every droplet touching that mass — no trail, nothing reaching for the frame edge.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Belly-first touchdown, chest low, shoulders taking the whole weight, fore-flippers splayed out and down for balance, a ripple travelling backwards through his blubber, whiskers forward, eyes squeezed half shut. A low contact crown of water bursting at the impact and clinging to his chest, kept inside the same box as idle.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on three-quarter travelling right mid-galumph: fore-flippers planted flat and turned out, spine humped into the inchworm arc, rear flippers whipping forward to catch up, head craned round just enough for the camera to get his face. Spray flicks off the flipper edges only — no drag streak, no wet road, and nothing asymmetric anywhere on him, because this frame gets mirrored.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: The same galumph flat out — inchworm arc snapped straight at full extension, flippers blurred, eyes wide, mouth open in a bark of pure commitment. Warm orange-and-white speed streaks laid along his flanks and belly so they touch the hide, plus one short tight burst of water off the rear flippers; no rooster tail, no long trail.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: He is NOT moving: planted dead still at three-quarter, chest up on the spinal arch, a lidded takeaway cup balanced perfectly on the very end of his nose because he cannot hold one, pupils shrunk to pinpricks, whiskers buzzing, mouth a tight flat line. Pale blush-cream steam off the lid (never pink), short warm fire licks and jitter ticks hugging his flanks — all the energy in the fur, none of it in travel.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Pure astonished delight: reared up from the ribs, mouth wide open, catching one hot chip clean out of the air, eyes enormous and lit up like the world just started working. Chips, fries and gold bottlecaps spiral inward on a tight orbit that overlaps his body all the way round, each piece touching the next so the ring cuts as one mass; no live fish, no spilled basket, nothing on the ground.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: A big black umbrella bitten by the SHAFT just under the canopy and laid back along his own spine so it rides over his shoulders like a lean-to roof, handle dangling past his chest; it covers his head and shoulders and comes nowhere near his back half, which is getting hammered. He is propped at three-quarter under the front rim looking straight down the lens, half-lidded and deeply smug — he does not need it and he knows it — rain sluicing off the canopy behind him, no dry patch, no ground.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: The hit lands: a bright blue-violet dome flares tight around him (never violet, never dark), and he turtles — chin jammed into his chest, neck compressed to nothing, whiskers flattened back, eyes screwed shut, fore-flippers clamped flat to his flanks. The umbrella is still in his teeth and blown clean inside out, ribs snapped upward into a bowl above him — the prop never leaves his body, and the whole thing stays inside the idle envelope.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Reared as high as a seal can rear: chest and neck stretched straight up while the back half stays a heavy sausage, foreshortened toward camera to keep the box near square. Head cranked back at the sky, eyes enormous, whiskers splayed, fore-flippers pinned in tight and low against his chest — only the top third of him is physically capable of panic.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Galumphing away in complete undignified terror, spine buckling in a big travelling wave, blubber a beat behind the motion, one rear flipper flailing clear, mouth open in a bark, head glancing back over his shoulder. Warm red-orange speed streaks painted onto his flanks and two small wordless shock marks tucked in close behind his head so they overlap his silhouette and survive the cut.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: The money shot — the one job his body is better at than anyone else's on the roster: reared up tall on his belly, head thrown back, mouth wide open barking with joy, both fore-flippers caught mid-clap LOW across his chest at belly height where a seal actually claps, never overhead. Water flicks off the flipper tips and a couple of gold sparks are caught between them, all of it touching him, and the reach stays inside the idle box so his head does not shrink.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Rolled onto his back on the road with all four flippers hanging out and up — inverted, so that is simply out-and-down along his body — tongue out the side, eyes closed into swooning half-moons (never X's), a ring of stars circling his head with each star touching the next so the ring cuts as one piece. One rear flipper crossed lazily over the other: he looks suspiciously comfortable, as though the nap was always the plan.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Belly-down and splayed, turning slowly flat on the spot like a compass needle that has lost north — he is a torpedo, never a coin balanced on edge — spiral eyes, tongue lolling, whiskers bent the wrong way. Motion arcs curl off both fore-flipper tips with a short spray ring flicking off them and a few sweeper bristles and grit grazing his flank, everything touching him; nothing whatsoever painted on the road.

splash.pose: Buoyant and furious: rolled onto his back inside a bursting white-blue-grey crown of water and carried off sideways at speed, whiskers bent back, one fore-flipper folded on his chest and the other flung out in a can-you-believe-this appeal to nobody, wearing an expression of enormous personal offence — this half of the map was supposed to be his. He rides high in the froth the whole time, mass centred, crown kept tight and well clear of every frame edge.

salmon.block:
Sockeye Salmon — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
No limbs and no feet: at rest he rears bolt upright on a fanned tail fin in a deep S-curve, a leap he never finished, and that tail-stand is his standing pose in every non-travel frame — travel is always a flip, never a run.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
In all 18 frames: spawning colours worn as the costume (crimson flank #d4685e, warm peach belly #f2b3a2, olive-green humped back and hooked kype) plus one snapped brass spoon lure tangled around — never through — the dorsal fin on a short frayed leader; the cheap black umbrella is the only other prop and it exists in frames 11 and 12 only.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
A salmon has no hands, so every raccoon pose is solved by the spine: the body curls, coils, arches and corkscrews, and the gill covers plus the one visible eye carry all the emotion. Pectoral fins sit low and BEHIND the gill covers and swing fore-and-aft through a few degrees only — they can never reach the eye, the top of the head, or under him as a weight-bearing prop, and they can never hold anything; anything he "carries" is hooked on the tip of the kype, stuck flat to the wet flank, tangled in the dorsal, or climbed into. He rears very tall, which blows the sizing envelope, so the painted box is held near square by making the S-curve deeper or shallower — never by shrinking the fish. Nose-to-tail and head size stay identical in all 18 frames; the head is the checkable proof.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Reared bolt upright on his fanned tail fin in a deep S, both pectorals held low and out for balance, olive kype level, the one big round eye fixed calmly on the viewer. Baked in: a wobble blur at the tail tip, rain beading down the crimson flank, the brass lure swaying on its leader against the dorsal — water only where it touches him, no puddle, no asphalt.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Balance abandoned: slumped onto his side and curled into a comma, gills working slow, tail fin idly slapping, one eye turned up into the rain, half-lidded and quietly melancholy. The frayed leader has coiled across his own belly with the lure resting on the flank, and a thin sheen of water clings to his underside without spreading past his outline.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Curled tight around a soggy paper tray of chips pressed against his own body, kype clamped sideways on a single chip like a caught minnow, eye blissfully shut, ketchup on the chin, lure glinting on the dorsal above. A real mayfly hovers an inch off his nose and is completely ignored — the one meal he was built for, and he has chosen chips.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Compressed into a tight loaded C, nose down, tail wound under him, pectorals flattened hard to the flank, the one eye locked up-screen, the whole body a spring at full compression. Water squeezes out along his belly line as a tight collar that touches him all the way round; the lure is pinned flat to the dorsal by the compression.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: HORIZONTAL frame, deliberately not cheer: a long low crescent travelling across the cell, tail kicked straight out behind, jaw SHUT, pale peach belly turned to camera, every scale catching the streetlight — pure speed, no celebration. A short sheet of water peels off the flank into a rope of droplets that stays on his body, lure streaming back along the dorsal.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Belly-flop: body slapped flat, head reared up with the jaw open in a silent oof, tail still up in the air a beat behind him so the box stays near square. A crown of splash bursts sideways right at his belly and stops there — no ripple, no ring, no wet road — and the lure has flipped forward over his shoulder on its leader.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Mid-flip to the right, body arced into a working comma, humped back cresting, one pectoral shoving off low while the tail whips through, head craned right, eye set and businesslike. Spray kicks off the tail close behind him and the lure and frayed leader swing back on the same beat.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: The same flip flat out: body stretched long, two or three tight afterimages of the tail beat, jaw clamped, eye wild, a short rooster-tail of spray at the tail. Warm orange speed streaks run along the flank and off the tail — never under his belly, there is no road — and the lure is snapped straight out behind on a taut leader.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: A STANDING frame, held up to seven seconds: planted on his tail and going nowhere, a takeaway cup hooked on the very tip of his kype and hanging clear to one side so the face stays open, coffee slopping over the rim. The whole body vibrates to a blur at the edges — gill covers flared, eye enormous with a pinprick pupil, jitter lines at the tail tip — with pale blush-cream steam (never pink) lifting off the cup and off his own hot flank.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Reared up on his tail with the jaw dropped open in flat astonishment — delight, not appetite — eye huge and shining as gold bottlecaps and chips spiral in on a short tight golden vortex that hugs his body. Four caps have already stuck flat to the wet flank like coins on glass, and the lure lifts on its leader as if it wants in too.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: He has flipped a cheap black umbrella canopy-up, let it fill with rainwater and climbed in — a fish in a bathtub — with the tub tipped toward camera so his whole head, kype, gill covers and dorsal ride clear above the rim, one eye half-lidded and unbearably smug. Canopy no wider than about 1.2x his tail-stand box so the crimson body beats the black bowl; lure and leader hang over the rim.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: The instant of impact: the umbrella-tub slammed sideways, water sheeting out over the bent ribs, and a blue-violet dome (never blue-violet, it gets eaten by the cut) flaring tight around fish and umbrella together. Body arched hard, pectorals splayed stiff and low, eye squeezed shut, rain streaking off the dome in bright lines, the lure flung up against the inside of it.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Rigid as a bowling pin on his tail and leaning back past vertical, dorsal fin snapped bolt upright with the lure standing up in it, both pectorals flared stiff and LOW like flinched shoulders, gill covers wide, mouth a tiny O, the one eye rolled straight up. A gull's wing shadow falls across his crimson flank only — never on any ground — and one bead of water flicks off the trembling tail tip.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Full panic flop up-frame: body zig-zagged mid-slap, three tail beats blurring, mouth wide in a silent scream, panic bubbles bursting from the gill covers, lure whipping loose behind. Three or four short run-off streaks that start and end ON his body run down past him while he angles up against them — no background wash, no symbols, no lettering.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: VERTICAL, the money frame and the opposite silhouette to leap: reared at full stretch bolt upright on a fanned tail, body quivering, jaw wide open in a joyful gasp, gill covers flared pink, every scale lit gold by hard backlight. The thrown water is only a contact burst at the tail base, no more than a third of his height, and the battered lure hangs off the dorsal catching the light like a medal. He got upstream.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his side in a puddle an inch too shallow to be dignified, gills still working, one pectoral flopped limp against the gill plate where it actually lands, jaw open with one fat comic bubble at the corner, small stars circling close over his head — embarrassed, not hurt. The brass lure has swung round on its leader and lies across his eye like a hat pulled down; rain lands ON him and a thin sheen of water hugs his outline, with no water painted anywhere it does not touch him.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Wrung into a hard corkscrewed C with the tail crossing PAST his head so the fin ends up beside his own jaw and the face rotates to camera — never wrapped around his own girth — both eyes spiralled, jaw hanging, gills fluttering. Wet leaves and stiff sweeper bristles stuck all over the flank with the lure tangled in among them, and a small tight tornado of litter and orbiting stars kept close enough to overlap his body; nothing on the ground.

splash.pose: The burst: he explodes up inside a white crown of storm water in a joy-roll, body twisted, tumbling and clearly knocked off his line rather than swimming, crown no wider than about 1.2x his idle box. Gills finally flared pink and working properly, eye wide with relief, lure flicking off the flank on its leader, streetlight refracting gold through the spray — the one death on the sheet that is secretly a homecoming, and he is still out of the game.

salmon.left: Paint run-l separately: the lure and its frayed leader hang off one flank and the kype hooks one way, so a mirrored run-r jumps the lure across the dorsal and swaps the eye to the far side on every leftward hop while the other seventeen frames never move it.
