orca.block:
Orca — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
His own thing — a beached orca: belly flat on the road at rest, fluke as both engine and brake, and every lift is a SPINE-arch with the flippers flared out sideways as balance outriggers, never as legs.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
One short frond of honey-brown bull kelp looped over the base of the dorsal fin and lying flat down both flanks — mid-value so it still reads as a band under any shop finish — and that is the entire wardrobe, present in all 18; the only other props are per-frame: paper chip tray (eat), takeaway cup plus two crumpled empties (coffee), patio umbrella (umbrella and shield).

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
Every raccoon pose is rebuilt from four parts: a fluke that is both the engine and the push-point, an enormous belly he travels on, two stiff pectoral flippers, and a dorsal fin that carries his whole mood. STANDING RULE ONE — the pectorals are low-set paddles with no elbow and no weight-bearing role: they flare OUT and DOWN as outriggers with the tips just kissing the asphalt, and they never go underneath him, never in front of or across the face, never above the head, and never hold anything against gravity. STANDING RULE TWO — every rear is a spine rear: a big arch from mid-body, chin thrown high, chest sliding up off the road with the fluke jammed down behind as the push point, silhouette of a rising black wave with two wings, never a propped-up sea lion. He does not hop, he porpoises in wet galumphing belly-arcs, and props are wedged behind the fin, laid on the flat of a flipper, or carried crosswise in the teeth — never gripped.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Belly flat to the road in three-quarter view, near flipper laid forward on the asphalt, fluke curled loose behind, dorsal fin upright with the notch clean against the sky and the kelp glossy over its base. White eye patch bright, mouth a small closed smile, rain beading across the wet black hide, and only a thin lace of contact spray where his belly meets the ground — no puddle.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: The quiet frame: a low spine-arch lifts his chest a few inches clear, fluke laid flat behind, both flippers slack out to the sides, dorsal fin tipping with the lean and the kelp hanging limp down his flank. Head turned away, chin low, eyes half-shut and far off — a pod animal listening for a pod that is not there.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Chin up on a low spine-arch with a battered fish-and-chips cod hanging crosswise out of his grin because he has nothing to hold it with, the soggy paper tray tipped up against his near flipper and chips stuck to the white of his jaw. The tray is no bigger than his eye patch; kelp flat along his back, rain pocking the hide.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Loaded and compressed: the whole mass pressed low, chin down, flippers flared hard out to either side with the tips just kissing the asphalt, fluke cocked up and back like a spring, dorsal fin raked forward with the gather and the kelp bunched at its base. A tight collar of spray squeezes out along the contact line under his belly; eyes locked forward, mouth a flat determined line.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: A three-quarter porpoise arcing toward the camera on a shallow diagonal — head near and large, back arched, fluke kicked small and far behind so the body foreshortens into the landscape box — flippers flared wide as wings, white belly turned to the viewer, kelp lifted along his spine. Short sheets of water peel off his flanks and one small burst ring hangs tight at his tail; jaws open in absolute delight, eyes squeezed into happy crescents.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Belly-first touchdown: chin down, jowls squashed flat against the road, flippers braced forward and splayed, fluke slapping down behind, kelp thrown forward over the fin. A fat crown of street water bursts sideways along his contact line and clings to his sides, and he blinks half-shut, entirely pleased with the mess he has made.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Full side profile travelling right in a long low galumphing arc, body barely clearing the road, near flipper reaching forward to pull and the far one paddling back, fluke kicked up mid-stroke, notch and kelp reading clean along the top of the silhouette. Spray fans off his belly as a short attached fringe — he carries no prop of any kind in this frame, and there is no skid line, wake or puddle behind him.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: The same galumph flat out: body stretched long and low, fluke a blur, both flippers slapping hard, kelp streaming tight along his flank, jaw open in a huge grin and eyes wide. Speed streaks rake short and tight against his flanks and the thrown water is cropped to a stubby attached rooster tail at his hip — nothing trailing off toward the frame edge.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: A STANDING frame — he is not travelling: belly planted dead flat, body held still and vibrating in place, pupils shrunk to pinpricks, dorsal fin quivering between short jitter marks and the kelp trembling with it. A tiny takeaway cup sits on the broad flat of his near flipper like a side table with pale blush-cream steam curling off it, two crumpled empties tucked in against that flipper's edge, and warm heat licks flickering along his contact line.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: A big spine-arch rear — chin high, chest sliding up off the road, fluke jammed down behind as the push point, flippers flared wide as outriggers with the tips only brushing the asphalt — jaws open in astonished joy, eyes round and shining, kelp slipped back along the arch. Gold bottlecaps, chips and fries spiral in tight against his chest and around the curve of his back, close enough to overlap him and glinting hard on all that black.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: A full-size café patio umbrella, shaft wedged behind the dorsal fin and lashed there with his own kelp, raked hard forward so the canopy sits over his skull like a hat brim with rain sheeting off the rim in bright arcs. Head and shoulders dry while the entire rest of that enormous back is still being hammered; half-lidded eyes, faintest smug smile — the canopy has to read as a roof in pure silhouette at 59px.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: The instant he eats a hit: chin jammed into his chest, head turned hard away from the impact, both flippers swept forward and cupped either side of the skull like blinkers, tips almost meeting but plainly framing the face rather than covering it. A bright blue-violet dome flares white-hot at the contact point with rain streaking off it, his mass shoved back a few inches with scraped spray at the belly line, one eye screwed shut, and the umbrella still lashed to the fin but blown inside out.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: A spine-arch rear staged as a steep diagonal, never a vertical column: chest up, fluke jammed down behind, flippers flared out and trembling with tips barely touching, head craned back and up at the sky. Eyes huge and perfectly round, mouth a tiny O in all that black bulk, kelp standing on end and a single bead of sweat flicking off his brow.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Galumphing away hard to the left in a flat panic, mouth wide, flippers flailing out of rhythm, fluke thrashing, dorsal fin leaning steeply into the turn and the kelp whipped back against his flank. Two fat exclamation marks sit tight over his shoulders overlapping his back, short red speed streaks rake his flanks, eyes white-rimmed and locked forward.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: A breach angled straight at the viewer on a leaning diagonal — front end thrown up and toward the camera, chin high, both flippers flung wide and open, jaws wide in a joyful open-mouthed shout, kelp flung up off the fin base but still looped on. A tight crown of spray bursts at the bottom of his own silhouette where the fluke slapped, a few gold bottlecaps confetti in close over his back, warm light catching the rain on all that wet black.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Rolled onto his side, white belly to the viewer, flippers limp in the air, fluke flopped over, dorsal fin lying flat sideways with the notch still readable and the kelp slid down over one brow. Eyes shut into swooning upturned half-moons, mouth slack in a small sheepish smile, three stars circling his head — wounded dignity, not injury, and nothing whatsoever painted on the road beneath him.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled belly-down in a loose S, spiral eyes, tongue lolling out one side of his jaw, dorsal fin bent right over like a wilted leaf with the kelp slipped down around his chin. Both flippers splayed uselessly out to the sides and three short wobble arcs tucked in against his cheek — spirals only, no stars, and no swept leaves or litter.

splash.pose: The instant of the burst: a white crown of floodwater explodes up around him and he is wedged in it to the shoulders, flippers flung up, a short spout puffing off his blowhole, kelp plastered flat and wet. Face caught between shock and a huge daft grin — the biggest animal in the game has finally found water and it only comes up to his chest — stuck fast and plainly out of play; he never sinks and never goes under.

orca.left: Mirror — run-r is deliberately prop-free and bilaterally clean (no cup, no umbrella, kelp draped centrally over the fin base onto both flanks, and the notch is in the fin's trailing edge so it flips true), so ship run-l as a flipped duplicate PNG rather than a repaint; it must exist as a file, because full characters do not auto-mirror and a missing run-l drops him to the procedural blob on every leftward hop. Cut frames land in assets/chars/orca/ as idle.png, sit.png, eat.png, crouch.png, leap.png, land.png, run-r.png, dash-run.png, coffee.png, magnet.png, umbrella.png, shield.png, scared.png, flee.png, cheer.png, ko.png, dizzy.png, splash.png

ghost.block:
Ghost Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Quadruped at rest — a plantigrade raccoon, four-square with flat palms, five long spread fingers and heels down, hovering a thumb's width above a ground that is never painted; he rears onto his hind legs ONLY in the frames that say so (coffee, magnet, umbrella, scared, cheer) and sits on his haunches in sit and eat.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
No costume and no permanent prop — he is bare; the only constants are anatomical (bone-white bleached fur, dark bandit mask, near-black OPAQUE sooty paws, faded stubby ringed tail, blue-white fray at shoulders, hips and tail tip), and there are exactly three frame-local props: a plain unprinted fry carton (eat, magnet), a plain unprinted takeaway cup (coffee) and one small umbrella (umbrella), each gripped in an opaque dark paw and touching the body.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He is a raccoon, so Jimothy's staging transfers pose-for-pose; the translation here is weight and opacity, not skeleton. Plantigrade in all eighteen — flat palms, five long spread fingers, heel down, never knuckles. Body canon holds: round and spherical, no visible neck, head perched high above the shoulders, long skinny limbs and a STUBBY tail in every frame — the vapour streams, the tail never does. The standing rule is that nothing bears weight: toes hang slack, no limb compresses, there is no cast shadow anywhere, and he never floats higher than the thumb's width he already floats — the float lives in the pose, not in extra height.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Four-square and plantigrade three-quarters to camera — bone-white bleached fur, dark bandit mask, stubby ringed tail, and near-black sooty paws as the only fully opaque part of him. Nothing takes weight: toes hang slack, no limb compresses, no shadow, just a thin ice-blue underglow touching the pads, and his big dark eyes are calm and faintly apologetic, like he knows he shouldn't be here.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: The quiet frame: sitting up on his haunches, dark paws folded on his belly, eyes half-closed, content but a shade lonely. His backside never quite settles and his hind feet hang slack; the wisps rising off his shoulders curl up and fold back into his ruff, never off the top of the frame.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sitting with a plain unprinted fry carton tipped against his chest, one sooty paw holding a fry at his mouth that never gets any shorter. A second fry has already fallen through him and lies solid and gold on his lap fur, a faint pale-blue trail down his chest marking the way it went; cheerful and mildly puzzled.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Flattened low, haunches up, forepaws braced wide with flat palms and five long spread fingers, eyes forward and huge. Nothing is compressed — the belly hangs clear and the gathered spring reads as ice-blue vapour clinging to his underside and streaming a short, tight way back off his hips.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne, limbs spread, belly forward, mouth open and delighted, stretched further than a solid raccoon could manage. Face and forepaws stay crisp; the hind legs give out into a blue-white vapour trail no longer than a third of his body, and the tail itself stays stubby — the vapour streams, the tail does not.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Forepaws down flat, palms and fingers spread, body low, whiskers forward, eyes startled that anything was there to land on. There is no impact: the trailing wisps fold forward and curl UP around his wrists and forelegs, attached to him — no ring, scuff or mist spreading out across a floor.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on travel right, body low, legs at full extension, the near-black plantigrade paws the only solid things in the painting. His hind quarter smears into pale blue fog with exactly ONE afterimage, offset a quarter of a body width so the two silhouettes overlap heavily; stubby tail throughout.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat-out sprint right, legs stretched, eyes wide, mouth open — where Jimothy throws warm fire he throws cold: short ice-white contrails off the heels and frost flecks that touch his hocks. His rear third has gone to vapour but is still opaque paint inside a continuous rim, with one heavily overlapping afterimage and nothing loose in the margin.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: A STANDING frame — he is holding still and vibrating: reared up on his hind legs, both sooty paws clamped round a plain unprinted takeaway cup at his chest, fur bristled, pupils shrunk to pinpricks, short jitter lines ticking off his ears and shoulders. The coffee is the most solid thing in the picture, a warm amber glow shining up through his ribs, its steam pale cream-white, with frost curls licking at his ankles where the living get fire.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Reared up on his haunches, mouth open in flat astonishment, one dark paw round the fry carton and the other thrown open wide as blank gold bottlecaps whirl in to him. The whirl hugs his torso so every cap overlaps his body — the ones passing behind him painted as dimmed, cooled discs ON his chest rather than gaps — and he is pure delight about it, never greed.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Reared up on his hind legs, smug and dry, one clearly opaque near-black paw closed round the handle of a small umbrella tilted forward over his skull, canopy compact and well inside the frame. The rain that misses it is painted as pale blue streaks ON his forearm just above the wrist, breaking into spray where it meets his paws — that contrast of solid paw and rained-through arm is the whole character in one frame.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Braced and flinching inside a close-fitting blue-violet dome that hugs his silhouette, paws up, eyes screwed half shut in relief. The dome's light pins a hard bright rim along the near edge of his fur and glows through him; short rain streaks skid off its outer surface.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Up on his hind legs, dark paws clutched to his chest, eyes huge and fixed up-screen at whatever is lining up its dive. He is so alarmed he has gone faint — the bottom third of him painted as a pale ice-blue wisp mass, still opaque inside a solid rim, curling up against his shins, with thin wisps streaming off his ear tips.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting hard to the left, mouth open in panic, both hind feet clear, stubby tail bristled. His panic reads cold rather than red — short white-blue smears and frost flecks attached to his flanks and heels, plus a small burst of ice-star shock sparks touching his head where a comic would letter punctuation; no marks, no lettering.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Reared tall with one sooty paw raised beside his head — compact, not a full overhead stretch, so his head stays the same pixel size as every other frame — mouth open in pure joy, hind feet dangling loose. Brightest and most solid he ever gets: a warm amber-gold glow rising through his chest, the fog blown back into a tight ring on his shoulders, because somebody finally saw him.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: On his back, front legs up, swooning half-moon lids and solid gold stars circling and overlapping his head — never X eyes, and never a hard horizontal cut line. His lower half is breaking into pale wisps that curl back UP toward his chest in a loop, re-gathering rather than dissolving, while one sooty paw lifts in a small apologetic wave: he cannot even be knocked over properly.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled with spiral eyes and tongue out, gold stars and wisps spiralling together and touching his head. His outline has come uncoupled into a second copy offset only a quarter of a body width, so the two silhouettes share most of their area — painted solid pale blue at reduced contrast, never a genuine fade.

splash.pose: The instant of shock inside an exploding crown of water: both sooty paws up, round shocked eyes, comically open mouth, fur soaked flat. Nobody sinks — the crown bursts white and ice-blue against his body, the water passing behind him painted as a dimmed cooled band ON his chest rather than a hole, and no piece of him is carried off downstream.

ghost.left: mirror — nothing on him is asymmetric, there is no lettering and no side-carried prop in run-r, so only the vapour fray flips and nobody reads drift as wrong in either direction. Cut frames land in assets/skins/ghost/ as idle.png, sit.png, eat.png, crouch.png, leap.png, land.png, run-r.png, dash-run.png, coffee.png, magnet.png, umbrella.png, shield.png, scared.png, flee.png, cheer.png, ko.png, dizzy.png, splash.png

richuncle.block:
Rich Uncle Jimothy — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
UPRIGHT AT REST — he sits back on his haunches or stands on his hind legs for every still frame (idle, sit, eat, coffee, magnet, umbrella, shield, scared, cheer) and drops to all fours ONLY for the six athletic frames (crouch, leap, land, run-r, dash-run, flee); he is never four-square with anything in a paw.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
IN ALL 18: black wet-silk top hat with an oxblood band and a soft battered brim; gold-rimmed monocle over his RIGHT eye (frame-left when he faces right) with a fine gold chain dropping to the waistcoat; cream wing collar with spread points; big oxblood bow tie with one gold stud; dark olive-brown buttoned waistcoat with small gold buttons; a heavier gold watch chain swagged across the belly of the waistcoat; and a SHORT oxblood shoulder cape over BOTH shoulders fastened at the throat — there is NO tailcoat and NO coat tails in any frame, the cape is the only garment that trails. Per-frame props only, never carried outside their frame: gold pocket watch (sit, magnet), takeaway fry box on a small silver tray (eat), doll-sized espresso cup (coffee), compact black umbrella (umbrella), and the identical gold bottlecap in dash-run, magnet, scared, flee, cheer, dizzy, splash.

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He is Jimothy's own body — round and spherical with no visible neck, the head perched high on the shoulders, long skinny limbs, and a SHORT STUBBY ringed tail; never the long streaming trash-panda tail, in any frame, including the sprints. Plantigrade throughout: flat palms, five long spread fingers, heels down — no knuckles, ever, and the hands are half of why the character works, so keep them readable even at speed. The hat, monocle and the two gold chains are HARD props sitting on a body that squashes and stretches, so they must be re-drawn honestly in each pose rather than smeared along with the fur — a warped top hat reads as a mistake instantly. His comic engine is that the body performs the entire athletic pose while the face declines to acknowledge it, and the hat is the mood ring.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Reared up and settled back on his haunches the way a man settles into a leather club chair — spine straight, belly forward, chin lifted, one flat forepaw laid on the waistcoat over the watch chain, the other hanging loose. Hat dead level with rain beading on the wet silk, monocle catching a single bright glint with its fine chain hanging plumb, stubby tail curled against his hip; amused, bored, and slightly damp.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: The same club-chair seat gone soft: hind ankles crossed, gold pocket watch open on his flat upturned palm, the heavy chain running taut back to the waistcoat, hat still dead level. This is his quiet frame — the monocle fogs a little with his breath and he is checking the time for an appointment nobody is coming to.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Sitting the same way with a dented takeaway fry box on a small silver tray balanced on his knee and resting against his belly, a white linen napkin tucked into the bow tie. He eats exactly one fry pinched between two claws with the pinky extended, eyes closed in mild approval, monocle fogged over from the steam and both chains undisturbed — still a raccoon eating garbage, just served properly.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Gathered low on all fours, chest near the ground, haunches up, flat plantigrade palms planted wide and loaded, stubby tail arched short over his back. Nothing in the face has changed: hat dead level, monocle seated with its chain hanging plumb, eyes forward and unhurried, like a sprinter who finds the whole business beneath comment.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: Fully airborne, belly forward, long forelimbs thrown wide with the fingers spread, hind legs trailing, the oxblood cape flared back off both shoulders. The top hat has lifted half an inch clear but still overlaps his ears, the monocle is somehow still in with its fine chain flying in a bright gold arc across his chest, and his face is serene — as though he is being carried rather than jumping.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Front palms slapped flat, body compressed low, hind legs still catching up, a tight white crown of street water bursting where his paws are and touching them — no puddle, no pavement, no shadow painted anywhere. The hat is settling back down with a fine ring of rainwater flicking off the brim, monocle level, watch chain still swinging, and his face is already composed.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Three-quarter sprint to the right — turned toward camera exactly like the shipped leap and land, never flat profile, so the monocle side stays visible — body low and long, forelimbs at full reach, stubby ringed tail held short and straight out behind. One flat palm clamped over the crown of the hat to hold it down, the other reaching forward, cape and both gold chains snapping back; absolutely nothing under him, no wet-street reflection and no shadow.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: Flat out, legs at full stretch, cape and both gold chains snapping straight back and the bow tie blown up under his chin — no coat tails, the cape is the trail. Short gold speed streaks touch his heels and four gold bottlecaps kick off his hind paws and stay tight behind him, while from the neck up he is entirely unchanged: hat dead level, monocle in, expression mildly bored.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: Feet planted, standing upright on his hind legs and going nowhere for seven seconds, and for the first time in his life visibly rattled — fur bristling out through the waistcoat, eyes enormous with pinprick pupils, monocle popped out and swinging on its chain, back heel a tapping blur. A doll-sized espresso cup pinched between two claws with the pinky out, pale blush-cream steam and warm gold jitter lines close around his shoulders; the hat is level but vibrating, and caffeine is the one thing old money cannot stay above.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Up on his hind legs with the pocket watch forgotten and swinging open on its chain, head up, both eyes wide and mouth open in unguarded delight — the one second old money forgets itself, astonished that the world is coming to him. A tight spiral of gold bottlecaps and fries curls in close around his chest and shoulders, every piece overlapping his body, three of them already caught in the upturned brim of the hat; monocle knocked cheerfully crooked.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Standing on his hind legs under a compact black silk umbrella with a brass handle held one-pawed, canopy no wider than his own body and tilted back so it stays well clear of the frame edge, top hat still on underneath it because he sees no contradiction. Rain beads and runs off the canopy rim in a tight bright ring touching the fabric — nothing on the ground, no dry patch and no shadow; monocle glinting, both chains still, eyes half-lidded and faintly pleased with himself.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: The instant the shield eats a hit: braced in a quarter-turn away, one flat palm up, a blue-violet dome flaring tight around him with rain streaking off its skin — bright and pale, never blue-violet. This is the only frame where the composure cracks: monocle knocked askew on its chain, top hat tipped down over one eye, mouth open in an undignified flinch.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Up on his hind legs, both forepaws clutched to the waistcoat, head craned up at the sky, eyes huge and round behind the monocle with its chain trembling. The top hat has jumped clear of his skull but still overlaps his ears, and three gold bottlecaps spill out of the inside of it and land on his head and shoulders — that is where he keeps it.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Sprinting on all fours hard toward camera-left but well clear of the frame edge, mouth open in real panic, one palm mashing the hat flat onto his skull, cape and watch chain flying, monocle bounced out and swinging wildly. Short red-gold speed strokes off his heels and two small exclamation strokes touching the hat brim; exactly two dropped bottlecaps tumble close behind, overlapping his stubby tail, and he is not going back for them.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Up on his hind legs in a grand full-arm doff, the top hat swept off and held high in one paw but angled inward over his own head so the whole hat stays inside the paint area, other arm flung up, mouth open in genuine unguarded joy. A short shower of gold bottlecaps pours from the upturned hat straight down onto his head and shoulders, touching him the whole way; the monocle catches one hard gold star of light and both chains swing.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back with his long legs straight up in the air and his flat palms limply open, bow tie shoved sideways, waistcoat rumpled, stubby tail folded under him and the cape spread out beneath his shoulders. Swooning half-moon lids — no X eyes — with slow gold stars circling above; the hat has come off and leans brim-down against his shoulder still touching him, and the monocle lies on his chest on its chain. The read is wounded dignity, not injury: he is mostly offended.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled on his side, spiral eyes, tongue lolling, the crushed hat jammed crooked over both ears so only his muzzle shows under the brim, monocle hanging off his cheek and full of rainwater on its chain. Stars orbit the wreck of the hat; one bottlecap sits on his chest, two are heaped against his shoulder, and one spins on its edge where it touches his open palm — none of them on the ground.

splash.pose: Caught inside the burst — soaked through with his fur plastered flat so he looks half his usual size, both forepaws thrown up, mouth open in pure shock, a white crown of water exploding tight around his middle. The top hat rides the near lip of the crown, brim-up like a little black boat with one bottlecap aboard and still overlapping his shoulder, and the monocle hangs full of water on its chain.

richuncle.left: MUST BE PAINTED SEPARATELY — mirroring run-r jumps the monocle onto his left eye and reverses both gold chains and the hat-clamping palm; paint run-l as the same three-quarter sprint facing camera-left with the monocle still over his RIGHT eye (now frame-right), chains and clamping paw re-drawn on the correct side, and note that a full character with a missing run-l falls through to the procedural coloured-blob fallback on every leftward hop. sasquatch.block:
Sasquatch — one of the playable characters in Jimothy, a storybook hopper set on the rainy streets of Seattle.

STANCE (locked — the same in every frame):
Upright bipedal at rest on two flat tan feet; drops to a four-point knuckle-bound (two flat feet plus two knuckles, never fists, never palms) for every travel frame — crouch, leap, land, run-r, run-l, dash-run and flee. The words "four-square" never apply to him.

WARDROBE AND PROPS (locked — these appear in ALL EIGHTEEN frames, including the deaths):
No clothing at all, bare shagged pelt only — and in all eighteen frames: a thin moss cap over his crown, plus on his LEFT shoulder a thick moss pad carrying two sword-fern fronds, a cluster of orange chanterelles, and a small rust-brown found umbrella wedged butt-down through the moss and angled back along his spine (stowed and closed in sixteen frames; lifted out and open only in umbrella and ko, and in both it stays physically touching him).

HOW THIS BODY WORKS:
He is an eight-foot, several-hundred-pound ape with full hands, so raccoon poses transfer honestly — the real translation problem is mass, and he must never read weightless. Because he stands upright at rest, both hands are genuinely free in idle, coffee, magnet, umbrella, shield, scared and cheer; the instant he travels he is on knuckles and feet, and no frame may silently swap the two. Every "coat" on this sheet is his own soaked shaggy pelt, not a garment — he wears nothing. Everything Jimothy plays fast, Sasquatch plays one beat slow: read the speed off the swinging pelt, the flung rainwater and the streaming ferns, never off his face, which holds the same mild patient frown through idle, sit, crouch, leap, land, run-r, run-l, dash-run, umbrella and shield — that hold IS the joke, and it only breaks for eat, coffee, magnet, scared, flee, cheer and the three deaths.

idle.inGame: standing, at rest — the default · on screen constantly
idle.pose: Upright on two flat tan feet, caught mid-step-back — weight rocking onto his heels, one huge palm half-raised as if he has just been seen, eyes cut off-camera under the patient half-frown of someone who has waited out worse rain than this. Long arms hanging past his knees, shoulders sloped, rain beading white through the dark pelt, teal rim light down both edges.

sit.inGame: 4 seconds without input · until the player moves
sit.pose: Sat straight down cross-legged and enormous, knees wide, one hand loose on his own ankle and the other palm turned up in his lap slowly filling with rainwater. Head tilted a few degrees, eyes soft and off to one side, watching a corner he remembers being something else — the quiet frame of the sheet; ferns hang forward off the shoulder garden.

eat.inGame: 8 seconds without input · until the player moves
eat.pose: Same cross-legged sit, but he has reached ACROSS with his far hand and picked one chanterelle off his own SHOULDER cluster, holding it up between two fingertips like a canapé, mouth just opening, eyes fondly crossed on it. The shoulder cluster is visibly one mushroom short; a few blackberries sit in his other cupped palm, collecting rain.

crouch.inGame: first quarter of every hop · 0.07s, hundreds of times a run
crouch.pose: Dropped into the knuckle-bound gather — both flat feet and both knuckles planted, back arched high so the mossy shoulder rises above his head line, haunches up, pelt hanging in wet ropes off his belly. Brow low, eyes forward and perfectly calm, a tight collar of spray bursting where each knuckle presses.

leap.inGame: middle half of every hop · 0.15s, hundreds of times a run
leap.pose: The airborne beat of a gorilla gallop: both long arms reaching FORWARD together, hands open and leading, shoulders and mossy back at the top of the arc, both legs gathered up under the belly, body long and heavy — mass in flight, never spread-eagle. Face completely unchanged, the same mild patient frown, pelt and ferns streaming back with flung droplets trailing off his heels and still touching them.

land.inGame: last quarter of a hop, plus a hold · 0.17s, hundreds of times a run
land.pose: Four-point touchdown, knuckles and flat feet planted, knees folded, head coming back up under the brow. A tight cyan-white sheet of splash bursts at each of the four contact points, water flicks off his elbows, the pelt lifts a beat behind him before it drops — the ferns bounce, he does not.

run-r.inGame: a sideways hop to the right · 0.28s
run-r.pose: Side-on knuckle lope to the right with the garden shoulder rolled forward and nearest camera, the leading knuckle planting no further ahead than his own body length while the far arm swings back to sell the span. Both hind legs swinging through underneath, pelt moving as one heavy mass, ferns and chanterelles leaning back, face level and unhurried, one tight flick of water off the trailing foot.

dash-run.inGame: hopping while the coffee dash is up · 0.19s
dash-run.pose: The same lope flat out — both feet clear of the ground mid-stride, arms driving fore and aft but the fingertip span held inside the aspect ceiling, pelt streaming behind him like a soaked rug, white speed streaks and a tight rooster-tail of rainwater breaking off his heels. Mouth shut, eyes calm, one eyebrow raised the smallest possible amount to acknowledge that he is now moving quickly.

coffee.inGame: STANDING STILL while the dash is up · 4.2s, or 7.0s on a Double Shot
coffee.pose: STANDING STILL — feet planted flat and square to camera, holding a takeaway cup so small he has to pinch it between two fingertips, pale cream-white steam curling past his nose. All the speed is in the body: pelt lifted and bristling with static, ferns standing straight up, jitter lines off his shoulders, orange fire licking up around his planted feet, and his eyes round and WIDE OPEN — the one frame where he looks properly awake.

magnet.inGame: standing while the Snacks magnet is up · 6.5s
magnet.pose: Standing upright with both arms spread low and open like a man about to receive a hug he has been owed for forty years, mouth open in a slow delighted "oh", eyebrows up in pure astonishment. Gold bottlecaps, fries and blackberries spiral in tight to his chest — the outer ones overlapping his silhouette and never more than a hand's width off the fur, several already stuck in the wet pelt, two lodged in the shoulder moss.

umbrella.inGame: standing while an umbrella shield is held · indefinite, until it takes a hit
umbrella.pose: Standing dead calm in pouring rain, the little rust-brown umbrella lifted out of the moss and opened across his own shoulder line with the canopy tipped toward camera, so the silhouette plainly says COVERED — canopy topping out level with the fern crown, no higher. Rain sheets off the near rim while his own face and beard get thoroughly soaked, the ferns underneath are conspicuously fluffy and dry, and he wears a faint smug half-smile.

shield.inGame: the instant the shield eats a hit · 0.55s
shield.pose: Braced upright with both forearms crossed high in front of his face and both feet planted, umbrella left stowed in the shoulder moss; a bright blue-violet dome flares tight around him — a hand's width off the fur, no taller than the ferns — with rain streaking off it sideways. Pelt and ferns flattened back by the shockwave, and his entire reaction to being saved is one raised eyebrow.

scared.inGame: a gull or crow is lining up a dive · 0.82 to 1.15s
scared.pose: Hunched down small and turned half away, hiding behind his own shoulder garden and peering out through the gaps in his huge splayed fingers — the alarm is being SEEN, not the bird. A hard wing-shaped shadow cuts across his chest, his other hand cups protectively over the moss and chanterelles, eyes enormous, mouth a small open O.

flee.inGame: the street sweeper is closing in · seconds at a time
flee.pose: Barrelling toward camera on a three-quarter angle in the airborne beat of the bound, both hands off the road — near hand clamped flat over the shoulder garden to stop the mushrooms bouncing off, far arm already reaching for the next knuckle plant. Mouth open in real alarm for the only time on the sheet, white and red speed streaks, twin exclamation strokes tight above his head, rainwater sheeting off the trailing arm.

cheer.inGame: LEVEL CLEAR — the camera zooms in on them · 2.6s, the biggest moment in the game
cheer.pose: Standing tall and square, chest out, head tipped back, both enormous arms raised in joy but ELBOWS BENT so his hands stay level with the fern crown and the frame stays exactly as tall as idle — huge open-mouthed grin, the only one he does. Second read baked into the same painting: one eye already sliding sideways to check that nobody watched him do it; water flicks off both forearms in tight arcs, warm gold light on the wet fur.

ko.inGame: death by traffic, gull or steam · 1.55s, camera leans in, light closes
ko.pose: Flat on his back, arms and legs sprawled up and out, pelt spread around him like a dropped rug, mouth open in a soft "oof" and one big toe twitching; eyes are swooning half-moons with stars circling his head and a fern sprig flopped down over one eye. The open umbrella leans against his own forearm, touching him, and his free hand is half-raised in a tiny apologetic wave to nobody — mortified at having been seen go down.

dizzy.inGame: death by the street sweeper · 1.55s, same treatment
dizzy.pose: Sprawled back on his backside with legs straight out, spiral eyes, tongue out the side, head lolling, stars circling. The street sweeper has scrubbed one absurdly clean bright streak straight through his soaked pelt and combed his shoulder moss into neat parallel rows, and a small tidy pile of swept leaves plus one plain dished hubcap sit in his lap, touching him.

splash.pose: Dropped straight down into the middle of an exploding crown of white water, water to his waist, both arms flung up clear of the burst — plainly out of play, not swimming, not sinking, the one thing in Seattle he is too big for and still losing to. Eyes wide and both eyebrows up in mild personal offence at the whole business, mossy shoulder hoisted high so the ferns and chanterelles stay perfectly, pointlessly dry above the churn.

sasquatch.left: Painted separately: the moss pad, ferns, chanterelles and stowed umbrella all ride his LEFT shoulder, which is the near camera-side in run-r — mirroring would swing the entire garden to the wrong shoulder, so run-l is painted fresh with the garden on the FAR shoulder, cresting over his back line so it still silhouettes.
